desc_zh: 從時空到國家，走進城鎮與街巷，探索 Rugatha 的地點、故事與冒險足跡。
desc_en: From realms and kingdoms to towns and winding streets, explore Rugatha's places, stories, and trails of adventure.

realms.desc_zh:
大部分冒險者與凡人出生、成長的時空。
儘管幾乎以常見的物理法則運作，魔法依然在這裡綻放。
realms.desc_en:
The realm where most adventurers and mortals are born and raised.
Though it largely follows familiar laws of physics, magic still flourishes here.

kingdoms.desc_zh:
以人類為主的王國，同時也有不少矮人和妖精以外的種族。
首都為麥克嵩。
貿易城市、港口與鄉鎮散布其間，貴族與宗教勢力比實質王權更大。
是冒險者旅程最頻繁踏級的國度。
kingdoms.desc_en:
A predominantly human kingdom, also home to many peoples other than dwarves and elves.
Its capital is Macksohn.
Trading cities, ports, and towns dot the land, where nobles and religious powers wield more influence than the crown itself.
It is the kingdom most frequently visited on the adventurers' journeys.

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國的貝瑟頓被稱為「貿易之都」，商業繁榮。
街上有糖果店、煙斗店與魔法用品店等各式商家。
而當中最有名的，便是當地知名的酒館「吟遊詩人之歌」。
城郊的幽深林，則是一般人不會涉足的危險區域。
cities.desc_en:
Known as the Town of Trades and Goods, Batherdon is a thriving commercial town in the Kingdom of Mattington.
Its streets offer everything from candy and pipe shops to stores selling magical supplies.
The most famous establishment is the local tavern, Song of the Bards.
Beyond town lies Deepwood, a dangerous forest that ordinary people avoid.

pois.desc_zh:
位於貝瑟頓城郊的樹林。
幽深林是居民對他的稱呼，並非實際的名稱。
據傳踏入這片林子很容易失蹤，也因此負責的衛兵對巡守的工作總是拚命推托，但最終還是會認命接下。
pois.desc_en:
A forest on the outskirts of Batherdon.
Deepwood is what the locals call it, rather than its actual name.
People are said to vanish easily within its trees, so the guards responsible for patrolling it try desperately to avoid the duty, though they ultimately resign themselves to it.

pois.desc_zh:
位於幽深林深處、供海妖墓園守墓人休息的小木屋。
里奇蒙爵士委託中尋找的寶箱便是放在這裡。
冒險團隊中途之家曾在此躲藏骷髏，並在木屋內過夜。
pois.desc_en:
A small wooden hut deep in Deepwood, where the keeper of Siren's Cemetery rests.
The treasure chest sought in Syr Richmond's commission was kept here.
The Halfway House hid here from skeletons and spent the night inside.

pois.desc_zh:
貝瑟頓巷弄中的魔法用品店。
玻璃櫥窗內陳列各種生命藥水，櫃檯附近另售發光、飛行、毒液與交換身分等特殊藥水，價格差距很大。
pois.desc_en:
A magic shop tucked into Batherdon's alleys.
Its glass display holds assorted healing potions, while special potions for glowing, flight, poison, and swapping identities are sold near the counter at widely varying prices.

pois.desc_zh:
位於貝瑟頓，外觀破舊的甜點店
販售老闆自製的各色糖果。
糖果鮮甜且價格便宜，冒險者羅羅曾買下整大袋帶走。
pois.desc_en:
A shabby-looking sweet shop in Batherdon.
It sells colorful candies made by the owner.
The candy is delicious and inexpensive; the adventurer Roel once bought an entire large bag to take away.

pois.desc_zh:
貝瑟頓的書店，也是冒險者毛毛熟悉的書店。
店員為湯普森，與毛毛和他的家人十分熟悉。
這裡是 T.I.D.E.S. 組織的相關商家，冒險者也從在這裡等候 T.I.D.E.S. 的馬車從這裡將他們載往諾曼爵士的宅邸。
pois.desc_en:
A Batherdon bookstore familiar to the adventurer Fur.
Its clerk, Thompson, knows Fur and his family well.
The shop is affiliated with T.I.D.E.S.; the adventurers waited here for the organization's carriage to take them to Syr Norman's estate.

pois.desc_zh:
位於幽深林山徑盡頭的墓園。
旁邊有守墓人的木屋。
冒險團隊中途之家依里奇蒙爵士的委託，前來尋找寶箱，並在此遭遇骷髏襲擊。
pois.desc_en:
A cemetery at the end of a mountain path in Deepwood.
The gravekeeper's hut stands beside it.
The Halfway House came here to retrieve a treasure chest for Syr Richmond and was attacked by skeletons.

pois.desc_zh:
位於貝瑟頓，販售平價煙斗的連鎖店。
購買煙斗可取得會員卡，並在其他分店享有優惠。
老闆也曾以會員卡，作為交換冒險團隊中途之家於幽深林見聞的報酬。
pois.desc_en:
A branch of a chain selling affordable pipes in Batherdon.
Buying a pipe earns a membership card that offers discounts at other branches.
The owner also offered membership cards in exchange for the Halfway House's account of its experiences in Deepwood.

pois.desc_zh:
貝瑟頓最有名氣的酒館，生意興隆。
冒險者團隊中途之家的成員在此相識，開始他們的冒險。
pois.desc_en:
Batherdon's most famous tavern, bustling with business.
The members of the Halfway House first met here and began their adventure.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 1: The Town of Trades and Goods

pois.desc_zh:
里奇蒙爵士的宅邸。
外觀已有些疏於照料，由僕人蒂娜照顧爵士與維持家務。
冒險團隊中途之家曾在此留宿、抵禦夜間闖入者，並在完成委託後領取戒指作為報酬。
大廳也掛著里奇蒙家族的家譜。
宅邸後方還有一處獨立的餐廳。
pois.desc_en:
Syr Richmond's estate.
Its exterior has fallen somewhat into neglect; the servant Tina tends to the Syr and maintains the household.
The Halfway House stayed here, defended it against intruders at night, and received rings as payment after completing its commission.
The Richmond family tree hangs in the hall.
A separate dining room stands behind the estate.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 1: The Town of Trades and Goods

pois.desc_zh:
貝瑟頓內色彩繽紛、充滿商業化裝潢的連鎖糖果店。
店內擠滿興奮的孩子，大把地抓取漂亮的糖果。
糖果按重量計價。
冒險者羅羅曾以昂貴的價格買了兩袋糖果。
pois.desc_en:
A colorful chain candy store in Batherdon with lavish commercial decor.
Excited children crowd inside, grabbing handfuls of pretty sweets.
Candy is priced by weight.
The adventurer Roel once bought two bags at a steep price.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 1: The Town of Trades and Goods

cities.desc_zh:
波馬贊是冒險者布朗出發的起點。
他從溫德一家接受護送委託，並與溫德家的巴哥犬瑪芬先生相遇。
cities.desc_en:
Bomozan is where the adventurer Brown began his journey.
He accepted an escort commission from the Wind family and met their pug, Mr. Muffins.

pois.desc_zh:
位於波馬贊的酒館。
由湯瑪斯經營，也提供住宿。
冒險者布朗詢問房間時，只剩已有房客入住的共用房。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Bomozan.
Run by Thomas, it also offers lodging.
When Brown asked for a room, only a shared room with existing guests remained available.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 1: Offer from the Wind Family

pois.desc_zh:
波馬贊當地小貴族溫德一家的住處。
屋前有一片種滿各種不同花朵的花園。
溫德夫婦、兒子彼得與巴哥犬瑪芬先生住在此處。
冒險者布朗曾上門商談護送一家人穿越森林的工作。
pois.desc_en:
The home of the Winds, a minor noble family in Bomozan.
A garden filled with many kinds of flowers lies in front.
Mr. and Mrs. Wind live here with their son Peter and their pug, Mr. Muffins.
Brown visited to discuss escorting the family through the forest.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 1: Offer from the Wind Family
Chapter 1: Offer from the Wind Family

cities.desc_zh:
以蜥蜴人為主要居民的城鎮。
與鄰近的龍人城鎮萊斯諾長期處於緊張關係：萊斯諾將此視為其屬地，並未放棄將其併吞的目標。
城內的新書院、老樹盟與公民聯盟各有不同政治主張。
最高領導者市長的選舉、新書院市長候選人皮尼歐教授遇刺，以及隨之產生的「新曙光」學運，導致原本熱鬧的街市陷入動亂。
cities.desc_en:
A town inhabited mainly by lizardfolk.
Relations with the neighboring dragonborn town of Leisnor have long been tense: Leisnor considers Clyphen its territory and has never abandoned its ambition to annex it.
The New Academy, Old Tree Alliance, and Civic Alliance hold competing political views.
The mayoral election, the assassination of New Academy candidate Professor Peneo, and the resulting New Dawn student movement plunged its once-bustling streets into unrest.

pois.desc_zh:
舉行市長候選人辯論會的大廣場，於辯論會設有舞台與主持人講台。
冒險者曾提前調查場地，隨後在辯論期間目睹皮尼歐教授遇刺與群眾情緒失控。
pois.desc_en:
The large plaza where the mayoral candidates' debate was held, equipped with a stage and a moderator's podium for the occasion.
The adventurers scouted the site beforehand, then witnessed Professor Peneo's assassination and the crowd's loss of control during the debate.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：藍色、紅色與土色

pois.desc_zh:
位於克萊芬城門內側的熱鬧市集。
攤販密集，人潮擁擠，充滿食物香氣。
冒險團隊中途之家初入城時，蜥蜴人拉比在此與冒險者雷亞搭話。。
pois.desc_en:
A bustling market just inside Clyphen's city gate.
Packed stalls and dense crowds fill the air with the aroma of food.
When the Halfway House first entered the city, the lizardfolk Ravi struck up a conversation here with Leah.

pois.desc_zh:
位於克萊芬城外白色小教堂後方草地上的小墓碑。
墓碑上刻著冒險者雷亞的父母，阿哈努與蕾絲塔的名字。
雷亞在讀完父母留下的信後，曾獨自在墓前獻花與悼念。
pois.desc_en:
A small gravestone on the grass behind the White Chapel outside Clyphen.
It bears the names of Leah's parents, Ahanu and Lesta.
After reading the letter they left behind, Leah came alone to lay flowers and mourn.

pois.desc_zh:
克萊芬政治派系新書院的聚會據點，設於學校內，辦公室由維安人員把守。
皮尼歐教授曾在此與幕僚準備辯論會並接見冒險團隊中途之家。
教授死後，瓦羅恩秘書長也在此處理派系事務，但這裡也成了「新曙光」學生撒野的地盤。
pois.desc_en:
The gathering place of Clyphen's New Academy political faction, based at a school whose offices are guarded by security personnel.
Professor Peneo prepared for the debate with his staff here and received the Halfway House.
After his death, Secretary-General Varoen continued managing faction affairs here, but the site also became a haunt for unruly New Dawn students.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：藍色、紅色與土色
第五章：沒有顏色是溫暖的顏色

pois.desc_zh:
克萊芬的利斯達上校所屬的老樹盟所在的軍營，外圍設有柵欄。
拉比與冒險團隊中途之家曾依循酒館包廂留下的氣味與他對老樹盟據點的記憶，追查至此。
立德上尉也帶著士兵們在此與冒險者們對峙。
pois.desc_en:
The fenced military camp of Clyphen's Old Tree Alliance, led by Colonel Lisdar.
Ravi and the Halfway House traced a scent left in a tavern booth to this camp, aided by Ravi's memory of the faction's base.
Captain Reid also confronted the adventurers here with his soldiers.

chapters.title_zh: 第五章：沒有顏色是溫暖的顏色

pois.desc_zh:
克萊芬的酒館，裡面有永遠都忙不完的店小二胡里歐。
一樓供應餐飲，二樓則有獨立包廂與可供住宿的房間。
冒險團隊中途之家曾以此作為於克萊芬的落腳處。
包廂也常被用來進行派系人士之間的秘密會談。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Clyphen where the server Julio is always busy.
Food and drink are served downstairs, while the second floor has private booths and guest rooms.
The Halfway House used it as a base during its stay in Clyphen.
Its booths are also often used for secret meetings between political figures.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：藍色、紅色與土色
第五章：沒有顏色是溫暖的顏色

pois.desc_zh:
位於克萊芬與萊斯諾城外樹林中的涅西斯教堂，老舊，但持續有人照料。
冒險者雷亞的父母曾在柳俠馬許的主持與拉比的見證下於此成婚，也在此斷了生命。
教堂辦公室保存著留給雷亞的信。
pois.desc_en:
An old but carefully maintained church of Nessis in the woods outside Clyphen and Leisnor.
Leah's parents were married here by Marsh the Willow, with Ravi as their witness, and also lost their lives here.
The church office preserves a letter left for Leah.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：藍色、紅色與土色
第五章：沒有顏色是溫暖的顏色

cities.desc_zh:
多倫維爾是一座賣丁頓王國的小城鎮，位於麥克嵩的西南方。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊乘馬車離開麥克嵩後，曾在此避雨與過夜。
城內有馬戲團旅店、醉漢酒館，以及早已歇業卻仍呈現往日景象的神秘旅店門羅公寓。
cities.desc_en:
A small town in the Kingdom of Mattington, southwest of Macksohn.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers sheltered from the rain and spent the night here after leaving Macksohn by carriage.
The town has a circus inn, The Drunk Man tavern, and the mysterious Monroe's Flat, an inn long closed yet still showing scenes of its past.

pois.desc_zh:
位於多侖維爾，由門羅家族世代經營的公寓式旅社，據路人所說已歇業五十年。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊入內後仍遇到接待客人的老婦人，並在半夜看見樓上反覆出現火災的異象與燒灼痕跡。
pois.desc_en:
An apartment-style inn in Dorrenville, run by generations of the Monroe family and said by passersby to have closed fifty years ago.
Inside, the Rugatha Plus adventurers nevertheless met an elderly woman receiving guests, then saw recurring visions of an upstairs fire and scorch marks during the night.

pois.desc_zh:
多侖維爾的酒館。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊為了避雨而入內，議價後租下大通鋪。
店內提供餐飲，但部分冒險者嫌價格太高，另到街上用餐。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Dorrenville.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers entered to escape the rain and negotiated a rate for shared sleeping quarters.
Food and drink are available, though some adventurers found the prices too high and ate elsewhere in town.

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國邊陲的小鎮，俗稱「鬧鬼荒野」。
鎮上的失憶事件與多年前侵害此地的怪物「偽多頭龍」有關。
而廢棄的貴族宅邸，卓茲克別莊地下的洞窟，則藏著另一段與月神芬尼爾有關，關於王冠、孽物與實驗的危險。
cities.desc_en:
A small town on the fringes of the Kingdom of Mattington, commonly known as Moorland Haunt.
The town's memory loss incidents are linked to a False Hydra that preyed upon it years ago.
Meanwhile, caverns beneath the abandoned noble estate of Drogskol Manor conceal another danger involving Phyneal, the god of the moon: a crown, abominations, and experiments.

pois.name_zh: 卓茲克別莊底下的洞窟
pois.desc_zh:
位於卓茲蘭的卓茲克別莊下方的洞窟。
是委託人「羽王」利希恩・阿莫雷要求 Rugatha Lite 的冒險者尋找月神王冠的地點。
洞窟與別莊相連，探索途中能遇到孽物與詭異的診療空間。
pois.desc_en:
Caverns beneath Drogskol Manor in Drogsland.
The Rugatha Lite adventurers were sent here by the Lord of the Feathers, Lithien Amore, to find the moon god's crown.
Connected to the manor, the caverns contain abominations and eerie treatment rooms.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：芬諾爾的傳道者

pois.desc_zh:
位於卓茲蘭，由烏鴉醫生經營的巫醫診所。
內部布置得如同叢林迷宮。
冒險者曾在此檢查失憶問題，並遇到能追蹤腐臭氣味的狗馬可。
烏鴉醫生也在這裡的牆壁上塗鴉了他在偽多頭龍事件失憶後，回想起的一些關鍵字。
pois.desc_en:
A witch doctor's clinic in Drogsland, run by Dr. Crow.
The interior resembles a jungle maze.
The adventurers came here to investigate their memory loss and met Marco, a dog able to track a putrid smell.
After recovering fragments of his memories of the False Hydra incident, Dr. Crow scrawled key words on the clinic walls.

chapters.title_en: The False Hydra of Moorland Haunt

pois.desc_zh:
位於卓茲蘭，貴族家族卓茲克一家的別莊。
地下連接藏有王冠的洞窟。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險團隊與 GoR 在其中遭遇化為魂魄的卓茲克爵士的力量。
直到戰鬥結束，原本無法開啟的對外大門才重新打開。
pois.desc_en:
The Drogskol noble family's estate in Drogsland.
It connects underground to the caverns where the crown was hidden.
The Rugatha Lite adventurers and GoR encountered the power of Syr Drogskol's spirit here.
Only after the battle did the previously sealed doors to the outside reopen.

pois.desc_zh:
卓茲蘭的酒館，是冒險者相識、用餐與打聽消息的場所。
現任老闆為雅各。他也曾於此請酒館內的所有酒客免費喝酒，來慶祝他的新婚。
酒館廚房後方曾藏著以記憶為食的偽多頭龍，與鎮上的異常失憶事件有關。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Drogsland where adventurers met, ate, and gathered information.
Its current owner, Jacob, once offered everyone free drinks to celebrate his marriage.
A memory-eating False Hydra once lurked behind the kitchen, causing the town's strange amnesia.

chapters.title_en: The False Hydra of Moorland Haunt

pois.desc_zh:
卓茲蘭的卓茲克別莊地下洞窟的實驗室，也是診療空間。
有貌似護士的孽物在內走動。
簾幕後的病床曾躺著伊娃，醫務櫃與書籍之中還藏有製造月神芬尼爾傳道者的線索。
pois.desc_en:
A laboratory and treatment space in the caverns beneath Drogskol Manor in Drogsland.
Nurse-like abominations move through its rooms.
Eva once lay in a bed behind the curtains, while medical cabinets and books concealed clues to the creation of Phyneal's preachers.

cities.desc_zh:
賣丁頓王國的方努爾市是以港口、渡船與運河連結各處的城市，也是 Rugatha Plus 冒險者米多莉的家鄉。
守護與正義之神津菈在當地具有重要影響，聖津菈大教堂、孤兒院、狂暴戰士幫與聖拉雅米島的事件彼此牽連。
cities.desc_en:
A city in the Kingdom of Mattington connected by its harbor, ferries, and canals, and the hometown of Midori from Rugatha Plus.
Keinra, the god of protection and justice, has great influence here; events involving the cathedral, the orphanage, the Berserker Gang, and St. Rayami Island are closely intertwined.

pois.desc_zh:
方努爾市對外航行的港口。
受羅賓遜主教委託尋找失竊魔法書的勇者，曾持介紹信到此尋找瑪琳船長，並登船出發前往後來被稱為「拉雅米島」的小島。
pois.desc_en:
Fanaur's harbor for voyages beyond the city.
The heroes commissioned by Bishop Robinson to recover a stolen spellbook came here with a letter of introduction to find Captain Marin and sailed for the island later known as Rayami Island.

chapters.title_en: The Lighthouse on the Deserted Island

pois.desc_zh:
方努爾市內的朱代卡運河，可搭乘當地的貢多拉通行。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者米多莉曾帶領同伴經由這條水路，迅速抵達聖津菈大教堂。
pois.desc_en:
A canal in Fanaur navigable by local gondolas.
Midori once led her Rugatha Plus companions along this waterway to reach the Great Shield Cathedral of Keinra quickly.

pois.desc_zh:
方努爾市內最大的津菈教堂。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者米多莉曾提及自己在這裡成長。
在月先生與紫羅蘭都無法收養波後，米多莉曾計畫將波帶回這裡生活。
冒險者們也曾到此拜訪羅賓遜主教，與回報任務的進展。
米多莉曾被關押於這裡的地下監獄。
通往尖頂寺的傳送陣，據說藏在這裡的地下空間。
pois.desc_en:
The largest church of Keinra in Fanaur.
Midori of Rugatha Plus has spoken of growing up here.
After neither Mr. Moon nor Violet could adopt Beau, Midori planned to bring Beau here to live.
The adventurers also visited Bishop Robinson and reported their progress here.
Midori was once held in its underground prison.
A teleportation circle leading to the Peak Temple is said to be hidden beneath the cathedral.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
方努爾市的軍用碼頭。
羅賓遜主教曾安排 Rugatha Plus 的冒險者夜間由此登船，前往娜塔夏港調查儀式，並尋找米多莉。
pois.desc_en:
Fanaur's military dock.
Bishop Robinson arranged for the Rugatha Plus adventurers to board a ship here at night, bound for Natasha Harbor to investigate a ritual and search for Midori.

pois.desc_zh:
方努爾市的咖啡廳。
水手會在工作之餘到此向年輕人談論天文與航海知識。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者米多莉童年時便在這裡接觸天文學，冒險者也曾受主教推薦前來休息。
pois.desc_en:
A cafe in Fanaur.
Off-duty sailors come here to teach young people about astronomy and navigation.
Midori first encountered astronomy here as a child, and the adventurers also came to rest on the bishop's recommendation.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

pois.desc_zh:
位於方努爾市，由軍營改建的孤兒院。
是冒險者米多莉、瑪莉與小雪童年成長的地方。
地下藏有魔法陣與拉巴比石，後續調查也揭露了孤兒販售與拉索斯教活動的線索。
pois.desc_en:
An orphanage in Fanaur converted from a military barracks.
Midori, Mary, and Snow grew up here.
A magic circle and Lababi stones were concealed underground; later investigations uncovered clues to orphan trafficking and Laxthos worship.

cities.desc_zh:
前往方努爾市所經的拉克渡口。
勇者節前聚集不少準備前往聖拉雅米島的旅客。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者曾因通往渡口的橋樑損壞而改道。
cities.desc_en:
A ferry crossing on the way to Fanaur.
Before Heroes' Day, many travelers bound for St. Rayami Island gather here.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers once had to take a detour after the bridge leading to the crossing was damaged.

pois.desc_zh:
拉克渡口狂暴戰士幫的三層宅邸。
一樓設有客廳，二、三樓各有五間房。
澤克與烏爾在此接待冒險者、安排住宿，並引導有意入幫者到地下室參加入會儀式。
pois.desc_en:
The Berserker Gang's three-story mansion at Lark Ferry.
The ground floor has a living room, while the second and third floors each contain five rooms.
Zek and Wull welcomed the adventurers here, arranged lodging, and guided prospective members to the basement for initiation.

pois.name_zh: 狂暴戰士幫地底競技場
pois.desc_zh:
藏在拉克渡口狂暴戰士幫幫會宅邸木地板下的圓形競技場，中央有坑洞。
欲入會者在此參加「狂暴之儀」，與塗裝成雕像的三名幫內人物希岡三世、耶內達特及烏爾交戰。
pois.desc_en:
A circular arena hidden beneath the wooden floor of the Berserker Gang's mansion at Lark Ferry, with a pit at its center.
Prospective members undergo the Rite of Fury here, fighting three gang members painted to resemble statues: Sigom III, Yennedat, and Wull.

pois.desc_zh:
位於拉克渡口的津菈教教堂，由韓神父負責。
韓神父曾於此說明非津菈信徒搭船的高額費用，並交付介紹信，引導 Rugatha Plus 的冒險者拜訪狂暴戰士幫。
pois.desc_en:
A church of Keinra at Lark Ferry, overseen by Father Han.
He explained the steep ferry fares charged to nonbelievers and gave the Rugatha Plus adventurers a letter of introduction directing them to the Berserker Gang.

pois.desc_zh:
拉克渡口附近熱鬧的酒館。
二樓有較為私密的用餐空間。
狂暴戰士幫的澤克曾帶 Rugatha Plus 的冒險者到此吃飯，並介紹瑪琳船長、莉蓮娜與拉芙。
pois.desc_en:
A lively tavern near Lark Ferry.
The second floor offers more private dining space.
Zek of the Berserker Gang brought the Rugatha Plus adventurers here for a meal and introduced Captain Marin, Liliana, and Ralf.

cities.desc_zh:
位於麥丁頓王國，雅洛斯地區地底的城鎮。
這裡由月神芬尼爾的靈魂議會統治，也是 Rugatha Lite 冒險者烏波真正的出生地。
城內分為六個受不同議員掌管的區域，各有影響身體的結界。
居民的工作、飲食與住宿都受到嚴格安排。
cities.desc_en:
An underground town in the Yaros region of the Kingdom of Mattington.
Ruled by Phyneal's Council of Spirit, it is also the true birthplace of Ubbo from Rugatha Lite.
The town is divided into six domains, each governed by a different councilor and enclosed by a barrier that affects the body.
Residents' work, meals, and lodging are strictly assigned.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札六大地區的「衰竭域」。
跨入結界便會感到氣管緊縮、呼吸困難。
巴斯曾在 Rugatha Lite 的冒險者越界前出面警告，並帶領他們前往靈魂議會。
pois.desc_en:
The Exhaustion Domain, one of Fenadra's six districts.
Crossing its barrier makes the windpipe tighten and breathing difficult.
Buzz warned the Rugatha Lite adventurers before they crossed and led them to the Council of Spirit.

pois.desc_zh:
位於菲納札的溫室。
種植菇類、食用植物與部分觀賞植物的工作場所。
新來者會被登記姓名，並依衣服顏色安排工作。
冒險者曾被分派從事搬土的初階勞動。
冒險者第一次在這裡的餐廳，吃到的晚餐是一大盆土與乾草，烏波卻對這樣的食物相當享受。
pois.desc_en:
A greenhouse in Fenadra.
Mushrooms, edible plants, and some ornamental plants are grown here.
New arrivals have their names registered and receive work assignments according to the color of their clothing.
The adventurers were assigned basic labor moving soil.
Their first dinner in the cafeteria was a large basin of soil and hay, which Ubbo thoroughly enjoyed.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札六大地區的「心空域」。
因原任心空席失蹤而出現權力空缺，消息卻遭議會封鎖。
領導者缺席期間，區域結界暫時失效，Rugatha Lite 的冒險者烏波也因此有機會爭取這個席位。
pois.desc_en:
The Hollow Heart Domain, one of Fenadra's six districts.
Its council seat became vacant when the previous holder disappeared, but the council suppressed the news.
With its leader absent, the district's barrier temporarily failed, giving Ubbo of Rugatha Lite an opportunity to compete for the seat.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札六大地區的「不動域」。
區域結界會使步伐沉重、移動遲緩，雙手也難以使力。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險者前往議會途中曾穿越這裡，切身體會不同區域的壓制效果。
pois.desc_en:
The Immovable Domain, one of Fenadra's six districts.
Its barrier makes footsteps heavy, slows movement, and weakens the hands.
The Rugatha Lite adventurers passed through on their way to the council, experiencing its suppressive effects firsthand.

pois.desc_zh:
位於菲納札心空域與不動域交界的工廠，有衛兵守門。
內部包含手術台、倉庫與會議空間。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險者烏波獲准進入後，見到與自身相似的血漿人及研究人員。
後來烏波也被這裡的人當作如神般的崇拜。
pois.desc_en:
A guarded factory on the boundary between Fenadra's Hollow Heart and Immovable Domains.
Inside are operating tables, storage rooms, and meeting areas.
After gaining permission to enter, Ubbo of Rugatha Lite encountered researchers and plasmoids resembling himself.
The people here later began worshiping him like a god.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札的管理階層「靈魂議會」。
位於一座六角高塔，每一面各有一扇帶著不同符號的門。
塔內設有議員的辦公空間，中央的流體柱能將訪客送往其他樓層與試煉場地。
pois.desc_en:
Fenadra's ruling Council of Spirit.
It occupies a hexagonal tower, with a differently marked door on each side.
Inside are the councilors' offices; a central column of fluid transports visitors to other floors and the trial grounds.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札靈魂議會高塔地下室的的試煉競技場。
由高塔中央流體通往的昏暗大型平台，四周環繞競技場般的觀眾席。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險者烏波在議員見證下參與爭取心空席的試煉，同伴也被捲入各項考驗。
pois.desc_en:
The trial arena in the basement of Fenadra's Council of Spirit tower.
Reached through the tower's central fluid column, this vast, dim platform is surrounded by spectator seating.
Before the councilors, Ubbo of Rugatha Lite underwent trials to claim the Hollow Heart seat, drawing his companions into the challenges as well.

pois.desc_zh:
斐納札內，供工人集中住宿的方形大樓，入口人員登記姓名並分配房號。
居民用餐後依序列隊前來，Rugatha Lite的冒險者們也在此獲得各自的房間。
pois.desc_en:
A square building in Fenadra providing communal lodging for workers, with staff at the entrance registering names and assigning rooms.
Residents line up to enter after meals; the Rugatha Lite adventurers also received individual rooms here.

cities.desc_zh:
位於麥丁頓王國南部的大學城是匯聚研究者與藏書的知識重鎮。
政治上，他不被王國管理，直接隸屬於帝國之下。
大學城內分為歷史、科技、自然魔法與法師魔法等四個區域，並定期從各區區長中選出一名作為城主，在中央塔辦公。
這裡的每個研究者都有屬於自己的住宅，風格各異。食物則可以在中央塔周邊的攤販圈領取。
大學城的維安管控嚴格，需有城內學者邀請，或本身具有學者身份，才會被放行進入。
cities.desc_en:
A center of learning in southern Mattington, gathering scholars and extensive book collections.
Politically, it answers directly to the empire rather than the kingdom.
The city is divided into History, Technology, Natural Magic, and Mage Magic districts; one district leader is periodically chosen as city lord and works in the Central Tower.
Each researcher has a home of their own distinctive design, while meals are distributed around the ring of stalls near the tower.
Entry is strictly controlled: visitors must be scholars or have an invitation from one living within.

pois.desc_zh:
位於大學城科技區內，工匠艾麗克斯研究機械與金屬材質的工作舖。
她對 Rugatha Plus 冒險者米多莉的金屬手臂十分感興趣，在掙得米多莉的同意後，將其金屬手臂拆卸研究，辨認出稀有材料「滑銀」，並在手腕內加裝可收納物品的長管。
pois.desc_en:
The workshop of Alex, an artisan researching machinery and metals in Great Citadel's Technology District.
Fascinated by Midori's metal arms, she obtained permission to dismantle and study them, identified the rare material Smooth Silver, and fitted a long storage tube into the wrist.

pois.name_zh: 安德烈亞・戴依的研究室
pois.desc_zh:
位於大學城內歷史區，區長安德烈亞・戴依的研究室。
研究室內，毒品「檸檬」的黃色粉末飄散其中。
安德烈亞主要在這裡研究宗教儀式，而蘿琳的靈魂正是在此被他的裝置攔截。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊曾來此請安德烈亞協助拯救蘿琳。
除了安德烈亞外，助理麥爾文也居住於此。
辦公室後的花園深處，埋著麥爾文失去靈魂的軀體，以及被冒險者龍恩擊暈的伊。
pois.desc_en:
The laboratory of Andrea Day, head of Great Citadel's History District.
Yellow powder from the drug Lemon drifts through the room.
Andrea studies religious rituals here, and his apparatus intercepted Roline's soul.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers sought his help to save her.
His assistant Melvin also lives here.
Deep in the garden behind the office lie Melvin's soulless body and Yi, whom Ron knocked unconscious.

pois.desc_zh:
位於大學城科技區內，珠寶匠安卓尼科斯的住處。
他曾在此與舊徒山田重逢，展示珠寶收藏，並以稱為「茶」的透明熱飲招待 Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊。
pois.desc_en:
The jeweler Andronikos's home in Great Citadel's Technology District.
He reunited here with his former apprentice Yamada, showed his jewelry collection, and served the Rugatha Plus adventurers a clear hot beverage he called tea.

pois.desc_zh:
大學城的中心，也是城主沙蘭・哈特洛辦公的地方。
，一樓可接待訪客，樓上另有藏書空間。
冒險者曾到此取得訪問許可、查閱資料並詢問交通與傳送門的消息。
周圍是一圈熱鬧的攤販圈。
pois.desc_en:
The heart of Great Citadel and the workplace of city lord Shalan Hartlow.
Visitors are received on the ground floor, with book collections upstairs.
The adventurers came here to obtain visiting permits, consult records, and ask about transport and portals.
A bustling ring of stalls surrounds it.

pois.desc_zh:
位於大學城中央塔樓上的禁書區，收藏一般區域之外的書籍。
一般來說不開放使用，需與城主沙蘭提出申請，才有機會使用。
然而，城主沙蘭曾直接允許 Rugatha Plus 的冒險者上樓查閱，眾人因此得以追查古老巫妖及其遺物的記錄。
龍恩也是在此得到巫妖的鉅著，瞬間從此傳送離開。
pois.desc_en:
The restricted collection upstairs in Great Citadel's Central Tower, housing books unavailable in the general sections.
Access normally requires an application to city lord Shalan.
Shalan nevertheless directly allowed the Rugatha Plus adventurers upstairs to investigate records of an ancient lich and his relics.
Ron also obtained the lich's tome here and was instantly teleported away.

pois.desc_zh:
大學城內法師法術區，烈焰術士茜卓・派松博士的住處，也是 Rugatha Plus 冒險者 YHWH 熟悉的寄宿地。
屋內分設研究室、圖書室、廚房與學徒生活空間，開門時會以火焰與「歡迎回家」的聲音迎接訪客。
在茜卓博士往生後，透過正當的行政程序，YHWH 成為了這裡的持有者。
pois.desc_en:
The home of pyromancer Dr. Chandra in Great Citadel's Mage Magic District, and a familiar lodging place for YHWH of Rugatha Plus.
It contains a laboratory, library, kitchen, and apprentices' living quarters, greeting visitors with flames and a voice saying, "Welcome home."
After Dr. Chandra's death, YHWH became its owner through the proper administrative procedures.

cities.desc_zh:
卡什拉是一座以前的小鎮，現已消失。地點位於現今麥丁頓王國境內。
這裡是索拉家所在的小鎮，索拉的父親彼特也曾是這裡的鎮長。
在 Rugatha Plus 的冒險中，卡什拉的幻境透過一間出入口異常的咖啡廳，與冒險團隊踏入的洞穴相連。
cities.desc_en:
A former town that has since vanished, located within what is now the Kingdom of Mattington.
Sora's family lived here, and his father Pete once served as mayor.
In Rugatha Plus, a vision of Kashla connected to the adventurers' cave through a cafe with an unusual doorway.

pois.desc_zh:
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者由洞穴內的門進入、內部空間異常寬廣的咖啡廳。
索拉帶領他們從原門離開時，門外卻成了農田。再步行約十分鐘便可到卡什拉的市區。
pois.desc_en:
An extraordinarily spacious cafe entered by the Rugatha Plus adventurers through a door inside a cave.
When Sora led them back through the same door, farmland lay outside instead. Kashla's town center was about a ten-minute walk away.

pois.desc_zh:
位於卡什拉，索拉家庭醫師瓦克松看診的地方。
冒險者曾在此詢問預言與索拉的身世，醫師說明預言是在匿名之聲教堂禱告時聽見的。
診所內似乎有神秘的力量，索拉也對此十分害怕。
pois.desc_en:
The clinic of Vaxon, Sora's family physician in Kashla.
The adventurers asked about a prophecy and Sora's origins; the doctor explained that he heard the prophecy while praying at the church of the Voice of Anonymous.
A mysterious power seems to inhabit the clinic, and Sora is deeply afraid of it.

pois.desc_zh:
位於卡什拉，索拉與其父母居住的家。
積滿灰塵的大宅，一樓為大廳，二樓是索拉的房間，三樓是父母的房間。
樓梯旁掛有家庭畫像，閣樓則藏著與索拉死亡儀式有關的始祖拉茲特獸。
家後有一座花園，花園裡有一座小木屋。
pois.desc_en:
The Kashla home where Sora lived with his parents.
The dusty mansion has a hall on the ground floor, Sora's room on the second, and his parents' room on the third.
Family portraits hang beside the stairs, while the attic conceals the ancestral Laztek connected to Sora's death ritual.
A garden behind the house contains a small wooden hut.

pois.desc_zh:
位於卡什拉的神秘書店，由自稱摩爾的店員接待。
書櫃放滿曾住過卡什拉之人的傳記，連剛抵達的冒險者也有自己的書，但當時內頁仍是一片空白。
pois.desc_en:
A mysterious bookstore in Kashla, attended by a clerk calling himself Moore.
Its shelves hold biographies of people who have lived in Kashla. Even the newly arrived adventurers have books of their own, though their pages are still blank.

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國的寇林菲爾德是冒險者帕拉丁成長的城鎮。
過去是弗列里爵士的封地，後來在麥克嵩比武大會，帕拉丁奪得冠軍後，巴納沃爵士將此地封給晉升爵位的帕拉丁爵士。
這裡有貴族宅邸、球場與教堂，也有酒館及盜賊公會。
台北市議員離開地下城後曾在此躲避與停留，尋訪家人與調查詛咒，最後在王國的衛兵追緝下，乘坐馬車逃往麥克嵩。
cities.desc_en:
A town in the Kingdom of Mattington where Paladin grew up.
Formerly Syr Flaerry's fief, it was granted to the newly knighted Syr Paladin by Syr Benevol after Paladin won the Macksohn tournament.
It has noble estates, a stadium, a church, taverns, and a thieves' guild.
The Taipei City Councilors hid and stayed here after leaving the dungeon, visiting family and investigating the curse before fleeing to Macksohn by carriage under pursuit by royal guards.

pois.desc_zh:
寇林菲爾德的酒館，可供冒險者用餐與打聽消息。
台北市議員曾在此遇見提供占卜的神秘老太太，後來再訪時卻未能找到她。
pois.desc_en:
A Korringfield tavern where adventurers can eat and gather information.
The Taipei City Councilors met a mysterious elderly fortune-teller here but could not find her when they returned.

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德，弗列里爵士與羅莎夫人的宅邸，設有藏書室與客房。
弗列里爵士曾於此接待台北市議員、讓他們查閱收藏，並安排房間作為暫時落腳處。
宅邸後方有專屬的用餐區域。
pois.desc_en:
The Korringfield estate of Syr Flaerry and Lady Rosa, with a library and guest rooms.
Syr Flaerry received the Taipei City Councilors here, let them consult his collection, and arranged temporary lodging.
A private dining area stands behind the house.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：寇林菲爾德的街道

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德小巷弄內的酒吧。
這裡也是弗列里爵士經常光顧的地方。
pois.desc_en:
A bar in one of Korringfield's narrow alleys.
Syr Flaerry is a frequent visitor.

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德，以石造拱門為入口的球場，場內熱鬧而充滿汗味。
冒險者帕拉丁年少時喜歡來這裡看棒球，弗列里爵士也曾帶眾人觀賞寇林菲爾德對麥克嵩的比賽。
球場周圍設有彩票購買處。
pois.desc_en:
A stadium in Korringfield entered through a stone arch, lively and filled with the smell of sweat.
Paladin enjoyed watching baseball here as a boy, and Syr Flaerry once brought the group to a Korringfield-versus-Macksohn game.
Betting booths stand around the stadium.

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德巷內的成人娛樂場所「七彩天堂」，可使用招待券並提供專人接待。
弗列里爵士曾資助冒險團隊「台北市議員」到此消遣，冒險者家亨在此度過了愉快的時間，雷米則偷了點東西。
pois.desc_en:
An adult entertainment venue in a Korringfield alley, offering personal hosts and accepting complimentary vouchers.
Syr Flaerry paid for the Taipei City Councilors to relax here; Jiaheng enjoyed his visit, while Lemmy stole a few things.

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德，冒險者帕拉丁的老家，由老僕人照料。
帕拉丁的父親馬格努斯爵士重傷返鄉後，在此接受哈洛威醫師治療，他也在這裡向帕拉丁透露生母身分，並提供離城的協助。
帕拉丁在這裡藏了不少私房錢。
pois.desc_en:
Paladin's family home in Korringfield, maintained by an elderly servant.
After returning home gravely wounded, his father Syr Magnus was treated here by Dr. Halloway. He also revealed the identity of Paladin's birth mother and helped him leave town.
Paladin keeps a substantial private stash of money here.

pois.desc_zh:
位於寇林菲爾德，外觀像連鎖雜貨店的「魔法師的雜貨店」。
前方販賣各式魔法用具，後方辦公室則可付費向「少年魔法師」諮詢（諮詢費可抵部分消費）。
冒險者烏柯與崔夏曾為解除魔法影響前來，並支付一百金幣的諮詢費。
pois.desc_en:
A Korringfield shop whose exterior resembles a chain grocery store.
The front sells assorted magical supplies, while the back office offers paid consultations with the young magician calling himself the Archmage; part of the fee can be credited toward purchases.
Uko and Trisha came to remove a magical effect and paid a hundred gold pieces for a consultation.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：寇林菲爾德的街道

pois.desc_zh:
橫跨沃瓦倫與寇林菲爾德的地下城。
冒險團隊台北市議員從沃瓦倫的寂靜殿向下走入地下城，最終從寇林菲爾德踏出。
裡面有不少拉索斯教的怪物與敵人，甚至藏有傳送的魔法。
pois.desc_en:
A dungeon stretching between Vowalon and Korringfield.
The adventuring party known as the Taipei City Councilors entered it beneath Vowalon's Temple of Silencio and eventually emerged in Korringfield.
It is inhabited by numerous monsters and other foes aligned with the Laxthos cult, and also conceals teleportation magic.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：寇林菲爾德的街道

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國境內的萊斯諾是以龍人為主的城鎮，也是冒險者雷亞的家鄉之一。
城內禁止騎馬。
儘管統治者為龍冠「賽爾斯・費利昂」，將軍瑪萊雅・凱耀才是實質掌握權力的人，主張以武力收回鄰近的蜥蜴人城鎮克萊芬，使兩地長期處在戰爭邊緣。
cities.desc_en:
A predominantly dragonborn town in Mattington, and one of Leah's hometowns.
Horse riding is prohibited within the city.
Although the Crown, Saerus Pharyon, is its ruler, General Maliya Kaeyal holds the real power. Her insistence on reclaiming neighboring Clyphen by force keeps the two towns on the brink of war.

pois.desc_zh:
位於萊斯諾，冒險團隊「中途之家」被衛兵押入、受命跪地接受質問的地方。
這裡也是萊斯諾的市政府。
瑪萊雅將軍、格雷斯卓大人與龍冠賽爾斯在此出面，最終要求中途之家前往克萊芬充當間諜。
pois.desc_en:
Leisnor's city hall, where guards brought the Halfway House and ordered its members to kneel for questioning.
General Maliya, Lord Galaestrel, and Crown Saerus appeared here, ultimately demanding that the group spy on Clyphen.

pois.desc_zh:
位於克萊芬城外白色小教堂後方草地上的小墓碑。
墓碑上刻著冒險者雷亞的父母，阿哈努與蕾絲塔的名字。
雷亞在讀完父母留下的信後，曾獨自在墓前獻花與悼念。
pois.desc_en:
A small gravestone on the grass behind the White Chapel outside Clyphen.
It bears the names of Leah's parents, Ahanu and Lesta.
After reading the letter they left behind, Leah came alone to lay flowers and mourn.

pois.desc_zh:
位於克萊芬與萊斯諾城外樹林中的涅西斯教堂，老舊，但持續有人照料。
冒險者雷亞的父母曾在柳俠馬許的主持與拉比的見證下於此成婚，也在此斷了生命。
教堂辦公室保存著留給雷亞的信。
pois.desc_en:
An old but carefully maintained church of Nessis in the woods outside Clyphen and Leisnor.
Leah's parents were married here by Marsh the Willow, with Ravi as their witness, and also lost their lives here.
The church office preserves a letter left for Leah.

cities.desc_zh:
麥克嵩是麥丁頓王國的首都，王宮、貴族宅邸、藝文特區與貧困舊城並存。
比武大會、宮廷鬥爭及藏在劇院地底的宗教活動，使冒險團隊台北市議員在此捲入多場重大事件。
在比武大會的惡魔入侵事件後，麥克嵩的人口僅剩 1/3，連原本百般刁難的衛兵，現在都意興闌珊。
cities.desc_en:
The capital of the Kingdom of Mattington, where the royal palace, noble estates, Arts District, and impoverished Old City stand side by side.
The tournament, court struggles, and religious activities hidden beneath the theater drew the Taipei City Councilors into several major events here.
After the demonic invasion at the tournament, only a third of Macksohn's population remained; even its formerly obstructive guards became listless.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩的藝文特區，有劇院、博物館、樂器商店與街頭表演者。
冒險者雷米曾帶同伴前來，薩梅爾也在這一帶演出並與月先生建立經紀關係。
pois.desc_en:
Macksohn's district of theaters, museums, instrument shops, and street performers.
Lemmy brought his companions here, and Samael performed in the area and established a management relationship with Mr. Moon.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：歡迎來到麥克嵩

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩，貴族伯納德・諾姆的宅邸。
這裡破舊但仍然典雅，二樓則藏有蜘蛛神教母親大人的床鋪。
貴族潘蜜拉等人夜間襲擊此處，馬可斯也出現在附近，這場事件成為追查貴族派系與政變計畫的線索。
pois.desc_en:
The Macksohn mansion of the noble Bernard Norm.
Worn but still elegant, it conceals a bed belonging to The Mother of the Spider faith upstairs.
Pamela and other nobles attacked it at night, while Marcus also appeared nearby, providing clues to noble factions and a planned coup.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩的伯納斯山丘上的伯納斯家族宅邸，進入內部須經過多層厚重雙門。
家族在此接待訪客、舉辦宴會，冒險者的樂團荒野旋律也曾受邀排練與演出。
pois.desc_en:
The Berners family's estate on Berners Hill in Macksohn, entered through several sets of heavy double doors.
The family receives guests and holds banquets here; the adventurers' band, Rhythm of the Wild, was invited to rehearse and perform.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩，通往伯納斯家族宅邸的山丘，以貴族伯納斯家族命名。
冒險者曾隨月先生上山拜訪，也有人在比武大會的混亂之後打算闖入宅邸搜刮財物。
pois.desc_en:
A hill in Macksohn leading to the Berners estate, named after the noble family.
The adventurers accompanied Mr. Moon up the hill, while some later planned to break into the estate for valuables after the tournament descended into chaos.

pois.desc_zh: 位於麥克嵩藝文特區內，艾德蒙餐酒館附近的簡易旅店「布蘭登的角落」。
pois.desc_en: A modest inn in Macksohn's Arts District, near Edmond's Diner.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩舊城區的布拉克家，過去曾為鐵匠鋪，如今殘破不堪。
布拉克受傷後，冒險團隊「台北市議員」曾將他送回家中。
布拉克臥房床下的洞口能通往複雜的地下通道，他也在這裡逐漸變化為拉茲特獸。
pois.desc_en:
Brock's home in Macksohn's Old City, formerly a smithy and now badly dilapidated.
The Taipei City Councilors brought him here after he was injured.
A hole beneath his bed leads to a complex network of underground passages, and it was here that he gradually transformed into a Laztek.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩小酒館。
冒險者蘇加魯曾獨自到訪，Rugatha Plus 的其他同伴則在貴族衝突後也躲到這裡調查事件，但沒有找到明確的魔法殘留或有用消息。
pois.desc_en:
A small tavern in Macksohn.
Sugalu visited alone, and her Rugatha Plus companions later sheltered here after a clash among nobles to investigate, though they found no clear magical residue or useful information.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩內大衛醫師接待病患與檢查傷勢的診所。
冒險者們將這裡視為可以安全躲藏與討論重要事宜的地方。
比武大會大屠殺事件後，這裡也成了傷患急救站與復原中心。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險團隊曾帶伊努前來求助，試圖解除詛咒，診所後來遭 YHWH 引起的火災與冒險者們的破壞而崩塌，迫使醫師轉移並要求賠償。
pois.desc_en:
Dr. David's clinic in Macksohn, where he receives patients and examines injuries.
The adventurers considered it a safe place to hide and discuss important matters.
After the tournament massacre, it also became an emergency station and recovery center.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers brought Inu here seeking help with a curse, but a fire started by YHWH and damage caused by the party eventually collapsed the clinic, forcing the doctor to relocate and demand compensation.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩，大衛醫師原診所附近的私人住處。
大衛醫師的弟弟「半神丹尼斯」也居住於此。
pois.desc_en:
Dr. David's private residence in Macksohn, near his former clinic.
His younger brother, Dennis the Demigod, also lives here.

pois.desc_zh:
高級餐廳艾德蒙餐酒館位於麥克嵩的分店。
位於藝文特區，崔尼斯劇院的正對面、以天藍色調為主的艾德蒙餐酒館分店，由店長路易斯管理。
冒險者龍恩曾在此展示廚藝，店家也負責伯納斯宴會的餐點。
店內設有不少包廂，老闆兼主廚也會在空檔到包廂拜訪用餐者，確保他們的用餐體驗。
pois.desc_en:
The Macksohn branch of the upscale Edmond's Diner.
Managed by Louis, this sky-blue restaurant stands in the Arts District directly opposite Trinix Theatre.
Ron once demonstrated his cooking here, and the restaurant catered the Berners banquet.
It has numerous private dining rooms; the owner and head chef visits diners between duties to ensure they enjoy their meals.

chapters.title_zh: 第四章：我們需要一個計畫

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩城內，由貴族凱文・波頓經營的「城門旅店」。
位於較貧困、治安不佳的舊城區，也因此房價較便宜。
冒險團隊台北市議員多次在此投宿，後來也曾租用共住的大房間。
pois.desc_en:
An inn in Macksohn run by the noble Kevin Bolton.
It stands in the poorer, less secure Old City and consequently offers cheaper rooms.
The Taipei City Councilors stayed here repeatedly and later rented a large shared room.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：歡迎來到麥克嵩

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩城門附近外觀破舊、價格划算的馬行。
老闆名叫賴瑞，凱莉是他老婆的名字。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者們曾在此購買雙頭馬車與馬匹，並獲贈一週份量的草料。
pois.desc_en:
A shabby but affordable stable near Macksohn's city gate.
The owner is Larry; Kerry is his wife's name.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers bought horses and a two-horse carriage here and received a week's supply of fodder as a gift.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩城內，「M 伯爵」馬可斯・詹斯的宅邸。
坐落於優雅而少有人跡的花園內。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險者們在此商議宮廷衝突、蜘蛛神教與營救馬可斯的妹妹瑪莉安的計畫，也曾在此遭遇貴族潘蜜拉手下的暗殺。
此處被冒險者們作為休息與照護同伴的據點。
反王派在鬥爭中取得優勢後，馬可斯與冒險者們逃離這裡，留下瑪莉安和正在復原的依在此休養。
pois.desc_en:
The Macksohn mansion of Marcus Jens, known as Count M.
It sits within an elegant, little-frequented garden.
The Rugatha Lite adventurers discussed court conflicts, the Spider faith, and plans to rescue Marcus's sister Marian here, and also faced an assassination attempt by Pamela's agents.
The party used it to rest and care for companions.
After the anti-royalist faction gained the upper hand, Marcus and the adventurers fled, leaving Marian and the recovering Yi here to rest.

chapters.title_zh: 第四章：我們需要一個計畫

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩城內，距離日出酒館不遠的「黃昏酒館」，布拉克過去曾在此演奏。
店內有魯特琴表演，冒險者也在此遇到黑斗篷男子，隨後發生布拉克昏迷的事件。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Macksohn not far from Sunrise, where Brock once performed.
It features lute performances; the adventurers also met a man in a black cloak here, shortly before Brock fell unconscious.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩最貧窮的舊城區，昔日商街已成為貧民窟。
區內巷弄複雜，蜘蛛神教受到多數居民支持。
水井與地下通道又連向更隱密的空間。
pois.desc_en:
Macksohn's poorest district, where former shopping streets have become slums.
Its winding alleys are complex, and most residents support the Spider faith.
Wells and underground passages lead to still more concealed spaces.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩王宮花園深處的圖書館，入內需接受守衛查驗。
櫃檯人員伊芙十分熱情，也熱愛談論八卦。
冒險團隊台北市議員曾在此查閱宗教、歷史與怪物資料，也在這裡追查隱形斗篷材料及蜘蛛王的線索。
pois.desc_en:
A library deep in the Macksohn palace gardens, with guards checking visitors at the entrance.
Its enthusiastic clerk Eve loves gossip.
The Taipei City Councilors consulted works on religion, history, and monsters here, and investigated the material of an invisibility cloak and clues about the Spider King.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩的貴族潘蜜拉・雅索接待貴族賓客的宅邸，屋內有交誼廳與氣氛昏暗的餐廳。
Rugatha Lite 冒險者華生曾受邀於此參與晚宴，藉此接觸伯納德、馬可斯與其他貴族，調查政變相關消息。
pois.desc_en:
Pamela Yaso's Macksohn mansion, where she receives noble guests in its sitting room and dimly lit dining room.
Watson of Rugatha Lite attended a dinner here to meet Bernard, Marcus, and other nobles while investigating a planned coup.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩，經紀人「月先生」使用的辦公室，可透過月先生提供的名片上的音符符號傳送抵達。
冒險者的樂團荒野旋律曾在此與月先生會面、準備演出服裝，也曾在危急時帶同伴前來求援。
在月先生消失後，這裡疏於照料。
pois.desc_en:
Mr. Moon's office in Macksohn, reachable by teleporting through the musical-note symbol on his business card.
Rhythm of the Wild met their manager here and prepared performance outfits, while the adventurers also brought companions here for help in emergencies.
The office fell into neglect after Mr. Moon disappeared.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩王宮外圍的花園，外側廣場有熱鬧市集，深處則連向圖書館、地下通道與比武場。
平常是貴族交際談事的場域，比武大會說明與報名也都曾在這裡進行。
pois.desc_en:
The gardens surrounding Macksohn's royal palace, with a bustling market in the outer plaza and routes deeper within to the library, underground passages, and tournament arena.
Normally a place for nobles to socialize and discuss business, it also hosted the tournament briefing and registration.

chapters.title_zh: 第四章：我們需要一個計畫

pois.desc_zh:
麥丁頓國王處理政務與接見貴族的王宮，由禁衛軍守護。
Rugatha Lite 的冒險者們曾以帕拉丁爵士的身分入內面見國王，並接觸宮廷研究、監禁與派系鬥爭。
pois.desc_en:
The palace where Mattington's king governs and receives nobles, protected by the royal guard.
The Rugatha Lite adventurers gained an audience through Syr Paladin's title and encountered court research, imprisonment, and factional struggles.

pois.desc_zh:
與麥丁頓王宮地下相連的監獄，部分區域如同一座由螢光照亮的小城。
可從王宮區域的洗衣房潛入，也連接到舊城區的水井口。
幾千年前這裡曾由機器人作為獄卒管理，在麥丁頓王國科技大衰退後，這裡無人管理，但因要逃到地表太過危險，大多數被囚者都放棄逃獄的希望。
瑪莉安・詹斯曾被囚於此，冒險者依靠魔法球指引深入，並將她救出。
pois.desc_en:
A prison connected to the underground levels of Mattington's royal palace, with some sections resembling a small, fluorescent-lit city.
It can be entered secretly through the palace laundry and also connects to a well in the Old City.
Thousands of years ago, robot wardens managed it. After Mattington's great technological decline, it was abandoned by its keepers, but most prisoners gave up hope of escape because reaching the surface was too dangerous.
Marian Jens was held here until the adventurers followed a magical orb into its depths and rescued her.

chapters.title_zh: 第四章：我們需要一個計畫

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩最大的酒館，是冒險團隊台北市議員初入城時的重要聚點。
冒險者龍恩曾在此煎製從沃瓦倫學來的牛排並意外熱賣，老闆喬納森的失蹤也引出後續調查。
接手的店小二法蘭奇將此店經營的奇差無比，在冒險者們將他裝進百寶袋後，此處無人管理，逐漸淪為廢墟。
pois.desc_en:
Macksohn's largest tavern and an important meeting place for the Taipei City Councilors when they first entered the city.
Ron cooked steaks he had learned to make in Vowalon, which unexpectedly became popular; owner Jonathan's disappearance prompted a later investigation.
The server Frankie took over and ran the business terribly. After the adventurers stuffed him into a Bag of Holding, the tavern was left unattended and gradually fell into ruin.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：歡迎來到麥克嵩

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩舊城區中，供奉蜘蛛神教母親大人的寺廟，外觀破舊並覆有蛛絲，像是久未維護的模樣。
母親大人因幫助貧民而受到支持，來訪者被要求保持恭敬，避免顯露貴族身分。
pois.desc_en:
A temple to The Mother of the Spider faith in Macksohn's Old City, shabby and covered in webs as though long neglected.
The Mother enjoys local support for helping the poor. Visitors are expected to show respect and avoid revealing noble status.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩的王宮花園深處、供比武大會使用的地下競技場，設有觀眾席與國王包廂。
賽事採淘汰制進行，後來因法蘭基化為惡魔而陷入大規模屠殺與混亂。
pois.desc_en:
The underground tournament arena deep within Macksohn's palace gardens, equipped with spectator seats and a royal box.
The competition used elimination rounds, but descended into massacre and chaos after Frankie transformed into a demon.

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩藝文特區的博物館。
純白的外觀，平時關著的雙開大門，外面掛著檔期展覽的旗幟。
pois.desc_en:
A museum in Macksohn's Arts District.
Its exterior is pure white, its double doors are usually closed, and banners outside advertise the current exhibitions.

pois.desc_zh:
藝文特區內的崔尼斯劇院，以潔白寬敞的雙開大門為入口，曾固定演出《崔尼斯簡史》。
劇院受伯納斯家族贊助，地下又藏有拉索斯教的聚會通道。
後來因冒險者於拉索斯教集會所縱火，導致劇院遭火災焚毀。
pois.desc_en:
A theater in the Arts District, entered through spacious white double doors and once home to regular performances of A Brief History of Trinix.
Sponsored by the Berners family, it also concealed underground passages to a Laxthos gathering place.
It later burned down after the adventurers set fire to the gathering place below.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：歡迎來到麥克嵩

pois.desc_zh:
位於麥克嵩藝文特區的高級旅店，一樓設有酒吧。
冒險者龍恩曾投宿於此。
這裡也是貴族諾曼家族贊助的場所之一。
冒險者同伴曾在此休息與會面，與貧民區的城門旅店形成不同的住宿選擇。
pois.desc_en:
An upscale inn in Macksohn's Arts District, with a bar on the ground floor.
Ron once stayed here.
It is one of the establishments sponsored by the Norman noble family.
The adventurers rested and met here, offering a different lodging option from Gates Inn in the poorer district.

pois.desc_zh:
麥克嵩藝文特區內，月先生舊識威廉經營的樂器行。
外觀雖破舊，樂器品質卻受到月先生肯定。
冒險者的樂團荒野旋律曾到此添購笛子、鈴鼓與提琴，準備正式演出。
pois.desc_en:
An instrument shop in Macksohn's Arts District, run by Mr. Moon's old acquaintance Willem.
Though shabby outside, its instruments have Mr. Moon's approval.
Rhythm of the Wild bought a flute, tambourine, and violin here in preparation for a formal performance.

cities.desc_zh:
位於麥丁頓王國的土城是中途之家冒險者阿龍成長的地方，是一座純樸的地侏城鎮。
這裡由三大家族組成的太陽議會處理城鎮事務。
每年會舉辦「春天精靈」的投票，被選中的未成年女孩會被帶到山上與山賊過夜，其家族則可取得物資。
這裡的安危受到附近海雅特山的山賊控制，需定期交付稅金給山賊，以維持土城的安全。
cities.desc_en:
A simple gnome town in the Kingdom of Mattington where Al-lon of the Halfway House grew up.
The Council of Sols, composed of three families, manages town affairs.
Each year, a vote selects a Spirit of Spring: an underage girl is taken up the mountain to spend the night with the bandits, and her family receives supplies.
Bandits on nearby Mount Hyatt control the town's safety, demanding regular payments to leave it unharmed.

pois.desc_zh:
冒險者阿龍養父母在土城的住處。
阿龍因曾誤傷父親而害怕返家，重逢時卻受到母親招待，並看見父親拐杖上刻著盼望孩子平安歸來的祝福。
pois.desc_en:
The home of Al-lon's adoptive parents in Mudtown.
Afraid to return because he had accidentally injured his father, Al-lon nevertheless received a warm welcome from his mother and saw a blessing carved into his father's cane, wishing for his safe return.

pois.desc_zh:
土城議員艾迪・蘋果木，與其子女佩妮、凱許的住處。
冒險者曾在春天精靈投票前來拜訪，卻遇上家人分別前往議會與廣場忙於選務。
pois.desc_en:
The Mudtown home of councilor Addie Applewood and his children Penny and Cash.
The adventurers visited before the Spirit of Spring vote, but family members were busy with election duties at the council and plaza.

pois.desc_zh:
靠近土城山邊的農地區，蘋果樹由蘋果木家族管理，並有農人看守。
中途之家冒險者曾想潛入採集特殊蘋果木，後來改與議會商議以剿除山賊交換材料。
pois.desc_en:
Farmland near the mountains outside Mudtown, where the Applewood family's apple trees are watched by farmhands.
The Halfway House considered sneaking in to collect special applewood, then instead negotiated with the council to obtain it in exchange for eliminating the bandits.

pois.desc_zh:
土城的政治中心，負責處理城鎮公共事務與春之靈選舉。
門口掛著寫有「謝謝太陽與河水，賜給我們小麥、蘋果和玉米！」」的布條。
主要由三名議員組成：蘋果議員（蘋果木家）負責外交，小麥議員（惠頓家）負責內政，玉米議員（康乃爾家）則負責娛樂。
艾迪等議員在此與冒險者談判，承諾以蘋果木與金幣作為剿除山賊的報酬。
pois.desc_en:
Mudtown's political center, responsible for public affairs and the Spirit of Spring election.
A banner at the entrance reads, "Thank you, sun and river, for giving us wheat, apples, and corn!"
Its three principal members are the Apple Councilor of the Applewood family, responsible for foreign affairs; the Wheat Councilor of the Wheaton family, responsible for domestic affairs; and the Corn Councilor of the Cornell family, responsible for entertainment.
Addie and the other councilors negotiated here with the adventurers, promising applewood and gold for defeating the bandits.

pois.desc_zh:
瑪莉貝爾・莫德維克在土城的住處。
因其父母長期在外處理外交事務，瑪莉貝爾獨自住在這裡。
春天精靈落選後，瑪莉貝爾為感謝中途之家冒險者投票支持自己，邀請大家到家中，親手準備午餐款待。
pois.desc_en:
Maribel Muddlewick's home in Mudtown.
She lives alone because her parents spend long periods away handling diplomatic affairs.
After losing the Spirit of Spring election, she invited the Halfway House over and cooked lunch to thank them for their votes.

pois.desc_zh:
位於土城外的海雅特山，山上有名為「海雅特山交響樂」的山賊聚落。
城鎮與山賊之間的衝突，成為冒險者取得特殊蘋果木的重要談判條件。
pois.desc_en:
A mountain outside Mudtown, home to a bandit settlement called the Mount Hyatt Symphony.
The conflict between the town and the bandits became a key bargaining point in the adventurers' efforts to acquire special applewood.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：山賊是一種心態
chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

pois.desc_zh:
土城邊緣海雅特山上，山賊集團「海雅特山交響樂」的聚落。
這裡有農場、牧場、餐廳、酒館與中央廣場，生活近乎自給自足。
山賊首領大奧斯曾帶中途之家冒險者參觀，說明山賊又受更大組織「砍殺交響樂」支配。
pois.desc_en:
The settlement of the Mount Hyatt Symphony bandits on Mount Hyatt at the edge of Mudtown.
With farms, pastures, a dining hall, tavern, and central plaza, it is almost self-sufficient.
Bandit leader Big Os showed the Halfway House around and explained that his people answered to the larger Slaughter Symphony.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：山賊是一種心態
chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

pois.desc_zh:
被土城當地人簡稱為「咖啡廳」的波德里克咖啡廳，設有包廂座位。
是土城當地最高級的咖啡廳，也是適合約會的場所。
冒險者阿龍曾在此與青梅竹馬佩妮見面，同伴也與佩妮的弟弟凱許一同到場，討論選舉及上山剿匪的想法。
pois.desc_en:
Mudtown's most upscale cafe, usually called simply the Cafe by locals, with private booths suitable for dates.
Al-lon met his childhood friend Penny here; his companions joined them with her younger brother Cash to discuss the election and the idea of attacking the mountain bandits.

pois.desc_zh:
位於土城外，赫洛登瀑布內峭壁上的喬里森神殿，也是萊里・里奇蒙主持的研究機構。
一樓設有接待區、禮拜堂、升降梯與二樓客房，萊里與助理「綠先生」的辦公室也在二樓。
是冒險者接受研究材料委託並暫住的據點。阿龍也曾接其養父母來此居住。
pois.desc_en:
A temple of Jeorisan on a cliff within Heloden Falls outside Mudtown, also serving as a research institute run by Riley Richmond.
The ground floor has a reception area, chapel, and lift; upstairs are guest rooms and offices for Riley and her assistant, Mr. Green.
The adventurers stayed here while accepting commissions for research materials. Al-lon also brought his adoptive parents here to live.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：山賊是一種心態
chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

pois.desc_zh:
位於土城，冒險者阿龍幼時就讀的「土堤學習中心」。
冒險者經過時，才得知阿龍曾在這裡上學，並對他仍不識字感到疑惑。
pois.desc_en:
The school in Mudtown that Al-lon attended as a child.
Passing by, the adventurers learned that he had studied here and wondered why he still could not read.

pois.desc_zh:
流經土城市中心的維爾河，與當地農作及議會頌揚的河流恩惠相連。
中途之家冒險者曾在廣場旁將臭味濃烈的「壞四人」皮柏丟進河中，強迫他清洗身上的髒污。
pois.desc_en:
The river flowing through central Mudtown, tied to local farming and the council's praise for the river's gifts.
Near the plaza, the Halfway House threw the foul-smelling Pibble of the Four Bad Guys into the river to force him to wash.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：山賊是一種心態
chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

pois.desc_zh:
位於土城市中心的軸恩廣場，維爾河流經廣場邊緣。
春天精靈候選人會在這裡帶隊遊行。
冒險者阿龍也曾在此再遇年少時欺負他的壞四人。
pois.desc_en:
A plaza in central Mudtown beside the Vay-El River.
Spirit of Spring candidates lead parades here.
Al-lon also encountered the Four Bad Guys here again, the group who had bullied him in his youth.

chapters.title_zh: 第二章：山賊是一種心態
chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: Banditry is a State of Mind

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國方努爾市一帶的娜塔夏港是一座衰敗而冷清的港鎮，由津菈教內戰戰敗的湯普森爵士治理。
「娜塔夏」即為湯普森爵士往生的妻子之名。他曾將此取名為「聖娜塔夏港」，但後來被方努爾市方撤除此名。
這裡同時有湯普森爵士設立的津菈舊教堂，也有方努爾市來的新教徒設立的新教會。
山丘上的湯普森宅邸，則隱藏著不死生物與月圓儀式的危機。
cities.desc_en:
A declining, quiet port town near Fanaur in the Kingdom of Mattington, governed by Syr Thompson, who lost the Keinra religious civil war.
Named for his late wife Natasha, it was once called St. Natasha Harbor at his insistence, until Fanaur removed the honorific.
It has both the old Keinra church established by Syr Thompson and a new church built by believers from Fanaur.
Thompson Mansion on the hill conceals a threat involving undead and a full-moon ritual.

pois.desc_zh:
位於娜塔夏港，由希娜修女負責的新津菈教會，位於村莊入口附近。
舊教堂在內戰後廢棄，後來從方努爾市來的教徒另建此處，Rugatha Plus 的冒險者抵港後也以這裡為暫時據點。
pois.desc_en:
A new church of Keinra near the entrance to Natasha Harbor, overseen by Sister Hina.
After the old church was abandoned following the civil war, believers from Fanaur built this one. The Rugatha Plus adventurers used it as a temporary base after arriving at the harbor.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

pois.desc_zh:
曾是娜塔夏港信仰中心的舊津菈教堂，在教會內戰後廢棄多年。
湯普森爵士利用此處不易引人注意的環境準備死靈儀式，Rugatha Plus 的冒險者們最後也在此與他及不死生物交戰。
pois.desc_en:
The former center of faith in Natasha Harbor, abandoned for years after the religious civil war.
Syr Thompson used its secluded setting to prepare a necromantic ritual, and the Rugatha Plus adventurers ultimately fought him and the undead here.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

pois.desc_zh:
位於娜塔夏港另一端山丘上的湯普森宅邸。
村民曾受邀參加晚宴，Rugatha Plus 的冒險者們則跟隨運送物資的彼得混入，發現守衛與宴會背後隱藏的不死生物陰謀。
pois.desc_en:
Thompson's mansion on a hill at the far end of Natasha Harbor.
Villagers were invited to a dinner here; the Rugatha Plus adventurers slipped in with Peter as he delivered supplies and uncovered an undead conspiracy behind the guards and banquet.

Chapter 4: Before the Next Full Moon

cities.desc_zh:
拉撒拿是一座建於山丘上的龍人城鎮，也是中途之家冒險者阿龍的出生地。
街道沿緩坡向上，貴族宅邸與統治者龍冠辦公處位於上城區。
世襲的龍冠艾瑞利斯家族負責管理這裡，阿龍也在意外的家破人亡後，接任成為拉撒拿龍冠。
城外的銀龍米札瑞爾對這裡有極其深遠的影響力。
cities.desc_en:
A dragonborn town built on a hill, and the birthplace of Al-lon of the Halfway House.
Its streets climb a gentle slope toward the noble estates and the Crown's offices in the upper town.
The hereditary Arylith family governs as Crown; after a sudden family tragedy, Al-lon succeeded to the title himself.
The silver dragon Myz'haril, who lives outside town, has a profound influence on Rathanad.

pois.desc_zh:
位於拉撒拿上城區、規模格外宏大的艾瑞利斯家族宅邸，冒險者阿龍的父母與叔父一家居住於此。旁邊設有馬廄。
艾瑞利斯家族重視魔法與繼承，宅邸也成為調查銀龍約定及爭奪龍冠的核心場所。
pois.desc_en:
The exceptionally grand Arylith family estate in upper Rathanad, home to Al-lon's parents and his uncle's family, with stables beside it.
The family prizes magic and succession, making the estate central to the investigation of its pact with the silver dragon and the struggle over the Crown.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：與艾瑞利斯一家的午餐
第四章：龍人血脈的永恆失落
chapters.title_en: Chapter 4: Eternal Loss of the Dragonborn Vein

pois.desc_zh:
拉撒拿上城區的議會廳，是龍冠處理公務的地方。
它與艾瑞利斯宅邸相鄰，構成拉撒拿山坡高處的政治活動區域。
pois.desc_en:
The council hall in upper Rathanad where the Crown conducts official business.
Standing beside the Arylith estate, it forms part of the political center high on the hillside.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：與艾瑞利斯一家的午餐

pois.name_zh: 哈洛・米佐的魔法商店
pois.desc_zh:
由銀龍化身「哈洛・米佐」經營、位於拉撒拿中城區的魔法商店，也是拉撒拿唯一的魔法用品店。
這裡曾遭狗頭人盜竊，也馬上被中途之家冒險者抓到，回報給哈洛。
作為回報，哈洛也讓冒險者在此挑選具有魔法的石頭。
pois.desc_en:
Rathanad's only magic shop, located in the middle town and run by the silver dragon in his guise as Harrel Mizel.
Kobolds once stole from it, but the Halfway House quickly caught them and reported to Harrel.
In return, he let the adventurers choose magical stones from the shop.

chapters.title_zh: 第一章：與艾瑞利斯一家的午餐

pois.desc_zh:
位於拉撒拿城外、由一群狗頭人看守入口的銀龍米札瑞爾洞穴。
冒險者阿龍的父親曾到此談判，以家族每代第一繼承人的魔法能力，換取銀龍不再侵襲村莊。
pois.desc_en:
The silver dragon Myz'haril's cave outside Rathanad, its entrance guarded by kobolds.
Al-lon's father negotiated here, offering the magical abilities of each generation's first heir in exchange for the dragon leaving the village unharmed.

cities.desc_zh:
朗甫頓是位於麥克嵩西北方的荒涼小鎮，商業規模不大，以酒館與旅店為主要落腳處。
麥克嵩比武大會事件後，不少居民從麥克嵩遷來，冒險團隊台北市議員也曾在此分隊，分別前往瑟巴諾與方努爾市。
cities.desc_en:
A bleak small town northwest of Macksohn, with little commerce beyond its taverns and inns.
Many residents moved here from Macksohn after the tournament disaster. The Taipei City Councilors also split up here, with groups heading separately to Sebano and Fanaur.

pois.desc_zh:
由酒館老闆推薦的「伐木人」旅社。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者米多莉與雷米各住單人房，其他同伴共用八人房。
眾人之後再準備返回麥克嵩。
pois.desc_en:
An inn recommended by the tavern owner.
Midori and Lemmy of Rugatha Plus each took a single room, while their companions shared an eight-person room.
The group later prepared to return to Macksohn.

cities.desc_zh:
位於麥丁頓王國的桑普塔諾是卓尼森帝國的首都。
冒險者依記憶返回時，才得知卓尼森帝國已被崔尼斯帝國取代，衛兵制服與統治者也隨之改變，城市仍以戒備森嚴的王宮為權力中心。
cities.desc_en:
Located in the Kingdom of Mattington, Samptano is the capital of the Dranison Empire.
Returning from memory, the adventurers learned that the Dranison Empire had been replaced by the Trinix Empire, with new rulers and guard uniforms. The heavily guarded palace remained the city's seat of power.

pois.desc_zh:
卓尼森帝國皇帝所在、戒備森嚴的王宮。
冒險者曾偽裝成新聘的平民工人混入，試圖尋找金庫，並向崔尼斯王朝的新帝霍里森一世通報邁爾斯坦巨像可能遭襲的消息。
pois.desc_en:
The heavily guarded palace of the Dranison emperor.
The adventurers infiltrated it disguised as newly hired common laborers, seeking the treasury and warning the new Trinix emperor, Hollison I, of a possible attack on the Mylstan Colossus.

cities.desc_zh:
瑟巴諾是麥丁頓王國境內，位於首都麥克嵩附近，被稱為「惡徒之城」的城鎮。
黑道霍布與手下掌握街頭勢力，對這裡的影響超過鎮長。
索恩鎮長家中曾藏有魔法盒子，地底更有鎮長夫人安娜的神秘實驗室。
cities.desc_en:
A town near Macksohn in the Kingdom of Mattington, known as the Town of Villains.
The crime boss Hobb and his followers command the streets and wield greater influence than the mayor.
Mayor Thorne's house once concealed a magical box, while his wife Anna's mysterious laboratory lay underground.

pois.desc_zh:
位於瑟巴諾，當地黑道霍布控制的酒館。
被霍布稱為自己的「遊戲間」。
外觀缺乏明顯招牌，窗戶封閉，像是秘密集會所一樣。
霍布顯露綁匪怪蛙形態後，遊戲間內外被詭異黏液覆蓋，黏液也逐漸形成冒險者的輪廓。
pois.desc_en:
A Sebano tavern controlled by the local crime boss Hobb, who calls it his playroom.
With no obvious sign and sealed windows, it resembles a secret meeting place.
After Hobb revealed his frog-like abductor form, strange slime covered the building inside and out, gradually taking on the adventurers' shapes.

pois.desc_zh:
瑟巴諾鎮長索恩的住處，藏有霍布要求 Rugatha Lite 冒險者偷取的魔法正方體盒子。
冒險者們初見伊努時，他正在房屋的背面縱火。
地下室藏有安娜的神秘實驗室，她在此將冒險者們的碎屑重新培育成他們的實體。
冒險者們曾在此與鎮長及安娜交涉，鎮長也向帕拉丁透露王位交接的消息。
在安娜將瑟巴諾滅鎮後，樓上儲藏間堆滿了謎樣的骨頭。
pois.desc_en:
Mayor Thorne's Sebano residence, where the magical cube Hobb ordered the Rugatha Lite adventurers to steal was hidden.
The adventurers first met Inu as he was setting fire to the rear of the house.
Anna's secret basement laboratory was where she regrew physical copies of the adventurers from fragments of their bodies.
The party negotiated with the mayor and Anna here, and the mayor told Paladin about the royal succession.
After Anna wiped out Sebano, mysterious bones filled an upstairs storeroom.

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國的夏庭森以石匠居民為主，對遊客來說，氣氛相當嚴肅而乏味。
夜間仍亮著燈的店家不多，冒險者布朗卻在其中一間商店見到雕工精細的國王紀念小像。
cities.desc_en:
A town in Mattington inhabited mainly by stonemasons, with an atmosphere visitors find stern and dull.
Few shops remain lit at night, but Brown discovered finely carved souvenir statuettes of the king in one of them.

pois.desc_zh:
位於夏庭森，夜間少數仍亮著燈、客人稀少的商店。
除了常見的石製品和工具外，也有不少老闆親自雕刻的歷史人物或知名人物石像。
pois.desc_en:
One of the few shops in Shartingson still lit at night, with few customers.
Alongside everyday stone goods and tools, it sells statues of historical figures and famous people carved by the owner.

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國內，方努爾市週邊的聖拉雅米島，與津菈教勇者的事蹟相連，燈塔旁的聖徒雕像是當地觀光景點。
島上後來發生失蹤與中毒事件，調查指向坍塌封閉的金海岸礦坑，以及藏在地下的拉索斯教活動。
cities.desc_en:
An island near Fanaur in the Kingdom of Mattington, associated with the deeds of Keinra's heroes. The saint statue beside its lighthouse is a local attraction.
Later disappearances and poisonings pointed investigators toward the collapsed, sealed Gold Coast Mine and underground Laxthos activities.

pois.desc_zh:
位於聖拉雅米島市中心噴水池與商店街附近、街角處的瑪琳船長住家。
樓上客房曾供 Rugatha Plus 的冒險者休息，眾人也在此交換島上的失蹤、中毒與礦坑調查消息。
pois.desc_en:
Captain Marin's house on a street corner near the fountain and shopping street in central St. Rayami Island.
The Rugatha Plus adventurers rested in its upstairs guest rooms and exchanged information about the island's disappearances, poisonings, and mine investigation.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
位於聖拉雅米島西側的金海岸礦坑，坍塌後封鎖，朗費羅是當年的唯一倖存者。
後來拉索斯教徒在地下活動，Rugatha Plus 的冒險者曾深入營救失蹤者，發現變異的拉茲特獸、炸藥與拉巴比石傳送法陣。
pois.desc_en:
A mine on the west side of St. Rayami Island, sealed after a collapse whose sole survivor was Ronfello.
Laxthos followers later operated underground. The Rugatha Plus adventurers entered to rescue missing people and discovered mutated Lazteks, explosives, and a Lababi-stone teleportation circle.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
聖拉雅米島上的酒館，販售朗費羅喜歡的海鮮湯。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者拜訪這位古怪礦工前，曾先到此買湯，希望藉此換得交談的機會。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern on St. Rayami Island serving Ronfello's favorite seafood soup.
Before visiting the eccentric miner, the Rugatha Plus adventurers bought soup here in hopes of persuading him to talk.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
位於聖拉雅米島上聖徒雕像附近的燈塔，是島上觀光景點周邊的重要地標。
獨居老人朗費羅的小屋也在這一帶，冒險者曾依線索前來尋人。
pois.desc_en:
A lighthouse near the saint statue on St. Rayami Island, an important landmark in the tourist area.
The elderly recluse Ronfello's hut is nearby; the adventurers followed clues here while searching for him.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
古怪獨居老人朗費羅位於聖拉雅米島的燈塔附近的小屋。
這名礦坑坍塌倖存者曾中毒，接受海鮮湯後才讓冒險者入內，並提供礦坑情報、煤油燈與金絲雀。
pois.desc_en:
The hut of the eccentric elderly recluse Ronfello, near St. Rayami Island's lighthouse.
The mine-collapse survivor had been poisoned and only admitted the adventurers after accepting seafood soup. He then provided information about the mine, a kerosene lamp, and a canary.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

pois.desc_zh:
聖拉雅米島上燈塔附近，紀念勇者的聖徒雕像，是島上知名的觀光景點。
相關紀念品包含聖拉雅米、轟雷牧師、守望者等勇者形象。
pois.desc_en:
A statue commemorating the heroes near St. Rayami Island's lighthouse, and one of the island's best-known attractions.
Souvenirs depict heroes including St. Rayami, the Priest of Thunder, and the Watcher.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones
Chapter 2: El Oro de los Ratones

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國的沃瓦倫是一座信奉拉索斯教的普通小村莊，卻因鎮長之子死亡與接連怪事而被認為受到詛咒。
冒險者將葛蘭倫大法師從隔壁鎮魏斯科帶回後一度被奉為英雄，但驅咒儀式最終導致災難，倖存者也因此背上「沃瓦倫的惡魔」之名。
cities.desc_en:
An ordinary Laxthos-worshiping village in Mattington, believed cursed after the mayor's son died and strange incidents followed.
The adventurers were briefly hailed as heroes for bringing Archmage Grenland from neighboring Wescoe, but the curse-lifting ritual ended in disaster, leaving the survivors branded the Demons of Vowalon.

pois.desc_zh:
連結沃瓦倫與魏斯科一帶的嚎叫森林，林中有狼群、河流與迷失方向的危險。
冒險團隊台北市議員為將魏斯科的葛蘭倫大法師請至沃瓦倫，曾往返穿越，並多次遭遇戰鬥。
pois.desc_en:
The forest between Vowalon and Wescoe, home to wolves, rivers, and the danger of losing one's way.
The Taipei City Councilors crossed it repeatedly to bring Archmage Grenland from Wescoe to Vowalon, encountering several battles along the way.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
拉索斯鎮鎮長戴洛・沃倫與妻子潔絲敏的住處。
冒險團隊台北市議員曾登門了解其兒子山米克死亡的經過，後來也在潔絲敏失蹤後前來探望與安慰鎮長。
pois.desc_en:
The home of Mayor Daryl Warren and his wife Jasmine in the Laxthos-worshiping town.
The Taipei City Councilors visited to learn about their son Sammick's death, and later returned to comfort the mayor after Jasmine disappeared.

pois.desc_zh:
位於沃瓦倫的旅店，由年輕老闆艾莉森經營。
受詛咒傳聞影響，當時少有外地客人，眾人也在夜裡經歷不安的夢境。
pois.desc_en:
An inn in Vowalon run by its young owner, Allison.
Rumors of a curse kept outside visitors scarce, and the adventurers experienced unsettling dreams at night.

pois.desc_zh:
位於沃瓦倫，由布魯斯・頓翰經營、鎮上最熱鬧的酒館。
冒險團隊台北市議員在此相識、用餐與交換消息，鎮民也曾在這裡慶祝葛蘭倫大法師的到來，稱頌眾人為沃瓦倫的英雄。
pois.desc_en:
Vowalon's liveliest tavern, run by Bruce Dunhan.
The Taipei City Councilors first met here, sharing meals and information. Townspeople also celebrated Archmage Grenland's arrival here and praised the party as the heroes of Vowalon.

pois.desc_zh:
沃瓦倫鎮上的拉索斯教堂「寂靜殿」，由寇頓神父主持宗教活動。
山米克失蹤時，便是在教堂門口的廣場。
葛蘭倫曾在此商議驅咒儀式，神殿內部也連向冒險者後來進入的地下空間。
寂靜殿前供鎮民聚集的廣場。驅除詛咒的儀式在這裡的廣場展開，原本慶祝英雄歸來的氣氛，隨後轉為災難與逃亡。
pois.desc_en:
Vowalon's church of Laxthos, where Father Kaulton presides over worship.
The plaza at its entrance was where Sammick went missing.
Grenland discussed the curse-lifting ritual here, and the temple connects to underground spaces the adventurers later entered.
Townspeople gather in the plaza outside, where the ritual began. What started as a celebration of the returning heroes soon turned to catastrophe and flight.

pois.desc_zh:
橫跨沃瓦倫與寇林菲爾德的地下城。
冒險團隊台北市議員從沃瓦倫的寂靜殿向下走入地下城，最終從寇林菲爾德踏出。
裡面有不少拉索斯教的怪物與敵人，甚至藏有傳送的魔法。
pois.desc_en:
A dungeon stretching between Vowalon and Korringfield.
The adventuring party known as the Taipei City Councilors entered it beneath Vowalon's Temple of Silencio and eventually emerged in Korringfield.
It is inhabited by numerous monsters and other foes aligned with the Laxthos cult, and also conceals teleportation magic.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

cities.desc_zh:
麥丁頓王國的魏斯科是熱鬧，受觀光客歡迎的城鎮。
與沃瓦倫鎮被嚎叫森林隔開。
廣場、餐酒館、恬靜花園與服從神社都是十分熱門的景點。
cities.desc_en:
A lively tourist town in the Kingdom of Mattington, separated from Vowalon by Howling Forest.
Its plaza, diner, Quiet Garden, and Shrine of Obedience are popular attractions.

pois.desc_zh:
魏斯科的酒館，冒險者布朗初入城時曾在此用餐。
這裡是他接觸梅莉、瑪蒂達與凱勒布兄弟，並打聽拉索斯信仰及黑蓮花消息的場所。
pois.desc_en:
A tavern in Wescoe where Brown ate when he first arrived.
Here he met Maylee, Matilda, and the Caleb brothers, while asking about the Laxthos faith and the Black Lotus.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
魏斯科當地的妓院。
梅莉與瑪蒂工作的場所。
pois.desc_en:
A local brothel in Wescoe.
Maylee and Matilda work here.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
位於魏斯科，艾德蒙餐酒館的本店。
以精緻餐飲聞名，麥克嵩另有分店。
冒險團隊台北市議員曾到此用餐，布朗也曾與昆妮在這裡共進晚餐。
pois.desc_en:
The original Edmond's Diner in Wescoe, renowned for fine dining, with another branch in Macksohn.
The Taipei City Councilors ate here, and Brown also had dinner here with Queenie.

pois.desc_zh:
連結沃瓦倫與魏斯科一帶的嚎叫森林，林中有狼群、河流與迷失方向的危險。
冒險團隊台北市議員為將魏斯科的葛蘭倫大法師請至沃瓦倫，曾往返穿越，並多次遭遇戰鬥。
pois.desc_en:
The forest between Vowalon and Wescoe, home to wolves, rivers, and the danger of losing one's way.
The Taipei City Councilors crossed it repeatedly to bring Archmage Grenland from Wescoe to Vowalon, encountering several battles along the way.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
梅莉在魏斯科的住處。
布朗曾在她受傷後陪同返回，並在此追查被藏起的瑪芬先生；這裡也是他與梅莉和瑪蒂達糾葛中的重要場所。
pois.desc_en:
Maylee's home in Wescoe.
Brown accompanied her here after she was injured and searched for the hidden Mr. Muffins. It is also an important setting in his entanglement with Maylee and Matilda.

pois.desc_zh:
魏斯科城內著名的景點，人潮眾多，由服務中心的人員管理。
稀有黑蓮花曾在這裡被目擊，冒險者布朗也曾來此尋花，並與昆妮在晚餐後散步。
pois.desc_en:
A famous, crowded attraction in Wescoe, managed by the service center staff.
The rare Black Lotus was sighted here; Brown came searching for it and later walked in the garden with Queenie after dinner.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
位於魏斯科，由卡魯神父主持的拉索斯教堂「服從神社」。
樓上收容孤兒，地下室則與拉索斯入教儀式有關。
pois.desc_en:
A church of Laxthos in Wescoe, overseen by Father Karu.
Orphans are housed upstairs, while the basement is connected to Laxthos initiation rites.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
位於魏斯科廣場旁的旅社，由諾曼爵士所有。
櫃檯曾對來自沃瓦倫的冒險團隊台北市議員顯露輕蔑態度，布朗也在此住宿並詢問黑蓮花線索。
pois.desc_en:
An inn beside Wescoe Plaza owned by Syr Norman.
Its reception staff treated the Taipei City Councilors from Vowalon with contempt. Brown also stayed here and asked about the Black Lotus.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 2: The Basement of the Shrine

pois.desc_zh:
魏斯科的市區廣場，夜間有衛兵來回巡邏。
冒險團隊台北市議員初次抵達時曾經過此處，並依守衛指引前往旁邊的庇護地旅社。
pois.desc_en:
Wescoe's central plaza, patrolled by guards at night.
The Taipei City Councilors passed through on their first arrival and followed the guards' directions to The Haven beside it.

pois.desc_zh:
位於魏斯科廣場一側，提供城市資訊並管理恬靜花園的服務中心，昆妮在此工作。
可以在此免費索取魏斯科的觀光地圖。
pois.desc_en:
A service center beside Wescoe Plaza, providing city information and managing Quiet Garden. Queenie works here.
Free tourist maps of Wescoe are available.

cities.desc_zh:
大部分是樹林的地區，位於麥丁頓王國與洛森王國的交界處。
斐納札位於此處的地底。
邊境有稀疏的妖精部落，常翠林的總部也坐落於此。
主要受到樹林與生命之神涅西斯眷顧，但月神芬尼爾對此也有些影響力。
cities.desc_en:
A mostly forested region on the border between the kingdoms of Mattington and Lothum.
Fenadra lies beneath it, underground.
Scattered elven tribes inhabit the borderlands, and Evergreen's headquarters is also located here.
The region is primarily blessed by Nessis, the deity of forests and life, though the moon deity Fenrir also holds some influence here.

pois.desc_zh:
位於雅洛斯地區，接近洛森王國的地點。
是樹林與生命之神涅西斯的一支分支。
常翠林有不少臨時的據點，總部則蓋在圓拱形的山丘底下。
pois.desc_en:
A site in the Yarros region, close to the Kingdom of Lothum.
Evergreen is a branch of the faith of Nessis, the deity of forests and life.
It maintains several temporary outposts, while its headquarters is built beneath a rounded hill.

cities.desc_zh: 麥丁頓王國有些地方因地處偏僻，或有特別的政治因素，導致未有管轄的城鎮。
cities.desc_en: Some places in the Kingdom of Mattington fall outside the jurisdiction of any town or city, either because of their remote locations or for particular political reasons.

pois.desc_zh:
諾曼宅邸是弗列德里克・諾曼爵士的私人宅邸。
這裡也同時作為 T.I.D.E.S. 組織的總部，每年會於此舉辦一次年度集會。
為保持此地的隱秘性，周圍設有結界，且來這裡的馬車上，除馬伕外，所有乘客皆會被魔法導致睡眠。
分為主建築、客房棟，與僕人房。主建築一樓為大廳，地下室為宴會廳；客房棟有兩層樓，一樓有部分客房與酒吧，二樓則全為客房。
pois.desc_en:
Norman's Estate is the private residence of Syr Frederick Norman.
It also serves as the headquarters of T.I.D.E.S., which holds its annual gathering here.
To keep its location secret, the estate is protected by magical wards, and everyone arriving by carriage, except the driver, is magically put to sleep.
The estate consists of a main building, a guesthouse, and servants' quarters. The main building has a hall on the ground floor and a banquet hall in the basement. The two-story guesthouse has some guest rooms and a bar on the ground floor, while the upper floor contains only guest rooms.

pois.desc_zh:
屋大維・馮。歐德里克大人新設的遊樂設施。
此處用來作為歐德里克大人經營的「密室脫逃」遊戲空間，但那是距今幾千年前的事了。
pois.desc_en:
A recreational attraction created by Lord Octavian von Oderick.
It served as the venue for the escape-room games he operated, though that was several thousand years ago.

pois.desc_zh:
位處荒野中，「羽王」利希恩・阿莫雷的神秘宅邸。
宅邸內有戴著鳥類面具的「羽僕」作為傭人，賓客則似遺忘時間的永遠待在大宅內狂歡，不曾停下。
在阿莫雷晉升為愛與永恆之神後，此處崩塌消失，後方則出現了一座愛神的殿堂。
pois.desc_en:
The mysterious residence of Lysien Amoret, the Feather King, set in the wilderness.
Servants known as Feather Servants wear bird masks, while guests remain in the mansion in an endless revel, seemingly oblivious to the passage of time.
After Amoret ascended as the god of love and eternity, the estate collapsed and vanished, and a temple to the god of love appeared behind it.

pois.desc_zh:
Rugatha Plus 冒險者龍恩長大的寺廟。
高聳的寺廟內有大量僧人，極度講求打坐與修行。
寺外有武僧定時守衛。
pois.desc_en:
The temple where Ron, an adventurer in Rugatha Plus, grew up.
The towering temple houses many monks and places great emphasis on seated meditation and spiritual training.
Warrior monks regularly stand guard outside.

kingdoms.desc_zh:
以妖精為主的王國，境內有非常嚴重的種族歧視。
首都為弗萊特境。
雖然貨幣系統仍然堪用，當地更偏好以物易物。
對外來旅人保持戒心，森林聚落與受尊敬的耆老是旅途中的重要節點。
境內以帳篷作為最主要的建築類型，與大自然融洽的整合在一起。
kingdoms.desc_en:
A predominantly elven kingdom marked by severe racial discrimination.
Its capital is Phreit.
Currency remains usable, but barter is preferred.
Outsiders are viewed with suspicion; forest settlements and respected elders are important stops for travelers.
Tents are the primary form of building, blending harmoniously with nature.

cities.desc_zh:
洛森王國的艾爾諾村位於與麥丁頓王國的邊界，居民多為半妖精。很少有會使用通用語的居民。
村中由長老與宗教領袖掌握重要事務，有著古老傳統的月神芬尼爾滿月儀式。
cities.desc_en:
A village in Lothum near the Mattington border, inhabited mostly by half-elves, few of whom speak Common.
Elders and religious leaders control important affairs, preserving an ancient full-moon ritual honoring Phyneal.

pois.desc_zh:
艾爾諾的中心廣場，也是滿月儀式舉行的地點。
古斯塔夫曾在此與村民起衝突，冒險者調查失蹤案時被帶到現場察看。
pois.desc_en:
El'Nore's central plaza, where the full-moon ritual takes place.
Gustavo once clashed with villagers here, and the adventurers were brought to inspect the site while investigating his disappearance.

pois.desc_zh: 艾爾諾宗教領袖教主大人的營帳。
pois.desc_en: The tent of El'Nore's religious leader, the Hierarch.

pois.desc_zh:
艾爾諾內，唯一的人類居民寇久經營的店舖。
主要販售日常用品與雜貨。
寇久曾協助冒險者營救同伴，並將冒險者藏匿於此。
pois.desc_en:
A shop run by Kojo, El'Nore's only human resident.
It mainly sells everyday supplies and groceries.
Kojo helped the adventurers rescue their companions and hid them here.

pois.desc_zh:
位於艾爾諾，馬法所有的鮮豔大型營帳，是外地人租借住宿用的營帳的地方。
馬法也雇用附近的孩童幫忙接待外來者和幫忙跑腿。
pois.desc_en:
Mafa's large, brightly colored tent in El'Nore, where outsiders can rent tents for lodging.
Mafa also employs local children to welcome visitors and run errands.

cities.desc_zh:
弗萊特境是洛森王國的首都，幅員廣大。
當地，對非妖精旅客頗有戒心，受尊稱為「師父」的耆老則能提供重要指引。
過去這裡曾是慶祝征服者洛林統一帝國的地方，也是蜘蛛王阿爾芬諾誕生之處。
cities.desc_en:
The sprawling capital of the Kingdom of Lothum.
Locals are wary of non-elven visitors, while an elder respectfully called Shifu offers important guidance.
The city once celebrated Lorin the Conqueror's unification of the empire and is also the birthplace of Alfenor, the Spider King.

pois.desc_zh:
弗萊特境在地耆老「師父」接待來客的帳篷，由雙胞胎莉娜與麗塔服侍並翻譯。
師父曾投影母親大人巢穴的地圖，也透過茶飲引發的異象，交付與旅途命運相連的神奇果實。
pois.desc_en:
The tent where Phreit's respected elder Shifu receives visitors, attended by the twins Rina and Rita, who also translate for him.
Shifu projected a map of The Mother's lair here and, through visions induced by tea, bestowed magical fruit tied to the travelers' destinies.

kingdoms.desc_zh:
以矮人為主的王國，境內也有半獸人、地侏、半身人等種族。
首都為歐倫，世襲的統治者多為女性。
王室曾委託冒險者尋回龍蛋，這件寶物後來成為王國持續供電與對外交易的重要資源。
kingdoms.desc_en:
A predominantly dwarven kingdom, also home to half-orcs, gnomes, halflings, and other peoples.
Its capital is Orun, and its hereditary rulers are mostly women.
The royal family once commissioned adventurers to recover a dragon egg, which later became an important resource for generating electricity and conducting foreign trade.

cities.desc_zh:
歐倫市是克里歐門王國的首都。
王宮內有大型的宴會廳，可宴請大量賓客用餐與飲酒。
cities.desc_en:
The capital of the Kingdom of Chryomen.
Its royal palace has a large banquet hall capable of hosting many guests for food and drink.

pois.desc_zh:
克里歐門王國收藏龍蛋的博物館。
龍蛋在供電二十多年後仍保有強大效力，克里歐門的烏瑪女王曾聘請冒險者護送它，準備與洛森王國交換妖精釀造的美酒。
pois.desc_en:
The royal museum housing Chryomen's dragon egg.
Still powerful after supplying electricity for over twenty years, the egg was entrusted by Queen Uma to hired adventurers for transport, to be exchanged with Lothum for fine elven wine.

pois.desc_zh:
克里歐門王室的宮殿，宴會廳經常用來款待受聘的冒險者與賓客。
宮殿樓上也提供客房。
pois.desc_en:
The palace of Chryomen's royal family, whose banquet hall often hosts hired adventurers and other guests.
Guest rooms are available upstairs.

cities.desc_zh: 克里歐門王國有些地方因地處偏僻，或有特別的政治因素，導致未有管轄的城鎮。
cities.desc_en: Some places in the Kingdom of Chryomen fall outside the jurisdiction of any town or city, either because of their remote locations or for particular political reasons.

pois.desc_zh:
克里歐門境內的一座山丘，人煙稀少。
中途之家冒險者雷亞的師父柳俠馬許定居於此，過著以大自然為家的修行生活。
pois.desc_en:
A sparsely inhabited hill in the Kingdom of Chryomen.
Marsh the Willow, mentor to Leah of the Halfway House adventuring party, lives here, pursuing a life of spiritual training with nature as his home.

realms.desc_zh:
充滿魔法與仙類生物的時空。
與物質時空並存、時間流速卻不盡相同。
各類仙類生物在此共同生活。
巨大帳篷是文明的主要集中地，帳篷外則是充滿野獸與未知危險的區域。
在巨大帳篷被攻陷後，這裡已成了拉索斯教的軍團佔據的地方。
realms.desc_en:
A realm filled with magic and fey beings.
It exists alongside the Material Realm, but time does not always flow at the same rate.
Many kinds of fey live here together.
Civilization centers on the Great Tent, while beasts and unknown dangers roam outside.
Since the Great Tent fell, the realm has been occupied by the armies of Laxthos.

kingdoms.desc_zh:
由妖精與其他仙類生物為主生活的區域，也是文明與秩序所在之處。
巨大帳篷是當中最主要的地點。
kingdoms.desc_en:
An area inhabited mainly by elves and other fey beings, and a center of civilization and order.
The Great Tent is its most important site.

cities.desc_zh:
妖精荒野中的巨大帳篷聚落，外圍繞行約需兩到三小時，內有妖精與其他仙類生物共同生活。
帳篷以巨大的中心樹撐起，中心樹保存集體記憶與知識。
醫療、休息、交易和試煉都在帳篷之內進行，後來因救世主預言與中心樹遭破壞而陷入災難。
cities.desc_en:
A vast tent settlement in the Feywild, taking two to three hours to walk around, where elves and other fey live together.
The immense Center Tree supports the tent and preserves collective memory and knowledge.
Healing, rest, trade, and trials all take place inside. A savior prophecy and the destruction of the Center Tree later brought catastrophe.

pois.desc_zh:
位於巨大帳篷正中央的中心樹，枝條上懸掛居民祈願。
觸摸者能讀取個人甚至出生前的記憶，也能向樹提問。
它同時保存妖精荒野的集體知識，但部分內容會被封鎖。
中心樹的樹幹可被魔法打開，踏入後可透過梯子走到地底下的集會所。
pois.desc_en:
The tree at the heart of the Great Tent, with residents' wishes hanging from its branches.
Those who touch it can access personal memories, even from before birth, and ask it questions.
It also preserves the Feywild's collective knowledge, though some information is restricted.
Magic can open its trunk, allowing visitors to enter and descend a ladder to the underground Assembly Hall.

chapters.title_en: Chapter 4: Trial of the Chosen One

pois.desc_zh:
白醫師艾爾比在巨大帳篷中使用的診療空間。
以白色簾幕分隔，設有多張病床與上鎖木櫃。
Rugatha Plus 的冒險者米多莉與波曾在此接受治療，失去的手臂也被精巧的金屬義肢取代。
後來龍恩也在這裡接受艾爾比的手術，裝上巫妖手臂。
pois.desc_en:
The treatment area used by the white-robed doctor Elby inside the Great Tent.
White curtains divide the space, which contains several beds and locked wooden cabinets.
Midori and Beau of Rugatha Plus received treatment here, with lost arms replaced by intricate metal prostheses.
Ron later underwent Elby's surgery here to receive a lich's arm.

pois.desc_zh:
巨大帳篷中，擺放多張圓桌的下午茶區。
英荻格曾在此招待冒險者，供應綠、藍、紫等不同顏色的清爽茶飲與層層堆疊的小糕點。
pois.desc_en:
An afternoon tea area inside the Great Tent, furnished with round tables.
Indigo entertained the adventurers here with refreshing green, blue, and purple teas and tiers of small pastries.

pois.desc_zh:
巨大帳篷的中心樹升起後，能經樹洞內的螺旋階梯抵達帳篷地下的大廣場。
居民圍在四周見證 Rugatha Plus 冒險者米多莉與波的「救世主」試煉。
後來中心樹遭攻擊，集會所也成為混亂與逃生的現場。
pois.desc_en:
A vast plaza beneath the Great Tent, reached by a spiral staircase inside the hollow trunk after the Center Tree rises.
Residents gathered around to witness Midori and Beau's savior trials in Rugatha Plus.
When the Center Tree was later attacked, the hall became a scene of chaos and escape.

realms.desc_zh:
與物質時空平行的時空。
被帶到此地的人待太久會被同化為無法逆轉的「深淵人」，並與原生生物共同存在。
各處聚落、獵場與研究場所，呈現出與地表世界不同的生存方式。
極少數人可以透過魔法在這裡與物質時空自由穿越，其他人則必須透過搜集並食用足夠的「巴坦蟲」，從這裡回到物質世界。
realms.desc_en:
A realm parallel to the Material Realm.
People brought here who stay too long are irreversibly assimilated into Deepfolk, living alongside its native creatures.
Its settlements, hunting grounds, and research sites reveal ways of surviving unlike those of the surface world.
A rare few can move freely between the realms through magic; everyone else must collect and eat enough Bach’tahn to return to the Material Realm.

kingdoms.desc_zh: 深淵內並沒有「國家」之分，皆以城鎮作為區分。
kingdoms.desc_en: The Deep has no kingdoms; its settlements are distinguished by town instead.

cities.desc_zh:
克勞辛頓是深淵中的聚居地，以有爪類的生物為主要居民。
派蒂介紹深淵地理時，特別提醒這裡的居民對深淵人十分不友善。
cities.desc_en:
A settlement in the Deep inhabited mainly by clawed creatures.
While explaining the realm's geography, Pattie specifically warned that its residents are extremely hostile to Deepfolk.

cities.desc_zh: 帕克提利克曾是深淵的首都，如今多有兇猛野獸出沒，能作為獵場。
cities.desc_en: The former capital of the Deep, now frequented by fierce beasts and usable as a hunting ground.

cities.desc_zh:
烏曼尼頓是深淵中以深淵人為主要居民的城市。
奈瑟學士的實驗室位於此處，研究出在深淵中真正結束生命的方法，因此在派蒂介紹當地地理時被特別提及。
cities.desc_en:
A city in the Deep inhabited mainly by Deepfolk.
Maester Nether's laboratory is here, where he discovered a way to truly end life in the Deep, earning the city a special mention in Pattie's account of the region.

pois.desc_zh:
由遭綁架至深淵的奈瑟學士設立的實驗室。
依派蒂的說明，奈瑟在此研發出自殺的方法，使這裡成為當時已知深淵內唯一能成功結束生命的地點。
pois.desc_en:
A laboratory established by Maester Nether after he was abducted to the Deep.
According to Pattie, Nether developed a method of suicide here, making it the only place then known in the Deep where life could successfully be ended.
